name: TITLE_PS
meaning: Not an event. This is title id 0, entry 0 of object table 0x1A0. InitializeObjectTable registers that table as class 0x01600007 with proc TitleProc, 0x100 slots of 22 bytes at RAM 0x032ABC. RegTitle 0 names this title "TT_PS" (string at 0xEB3688), and it is the home title of mode 0, "MD_PS". The value has two roles. (1) It is the null or fallback title. When a mode or title slot is unregistered (0xFFFFFFFF), ModeProc and TitleProc write it into the current-title variable 0x03EF8A. A view's target-title field (+26) holding this value means 'no target'; the naka C structs write `.exit = 0x01A00000` 74 times. (2) It is the base of title-id arithmetic, title id = 0x01A00000 + n (17 add sites). Suggest the alias `.equ TITLE_ID_BASE, TITLE_PS` for the add/sub sites and TITLE_PS for the ld/cp sites.
evidence: Table registration: InitializeObjectTable@0xFA40B3 (ui_widget_defs.s:8712-8721) registers table 0x1A0 with class 0x01600007, proc TitleProc@0xFA4E03, 0x100 slots at 0x032ABC. RegisterTitle@0xFA4D80 fills each 22-byte slot. Name: InitializeRoot@0xFB28CB, graphics_text_vga.s:2330 `RegTitle ...,0x0` gives "TT_PS"; :2328 `RegMode` gives mode 0 "MD_PS" home title 0x01A00000. Fallback writes: ModeProc ObjectEnum_OK_Dispatch@0xFA4C52 sets mode 0x01800000 and title 0x01A00000 when the mode slot's home title is 0xFFFFFFFF; TitleProc EventDispatch_ConfirmSetup@0xFA5083 and EventDispatch_Default@0xFA51C4 do the same for the title. Sentinel test: Screen_OK@0xF9A887 compares view+26 with it and posts 0x01C00015 only when it differs. Senders of title 0: CtrlPanel_PostDisplayEvent@0xF982E2 posts 0x01C00015 with XDE=0x01A00000; MainTitle_InitGraphicsAndEvents@0xF9800F sends 0x01E0009E straight to object 0x01A00000. Base arithmetic: UI_PostModeChangeEvent@0xF99490 (0x01C00015), SoundCtrl_SendCommand@0xF994BD (0x01C00016), HDAE5000_RequestTitle15@0x28AC68, HDAE5000_RequestTitle16@0x28ACB1, MsgToTtl_CheckTitleAndPost@0xF2F057, EffectMode_DiagSeq_AnimFrame@0xFB7B01, TitleProc EventDispatch_OK@0xFA50B1 (slot words +18 and +20 become title ids) and EventDispatch_Return@0xFA523F. The ViewID/ScreenID/WindowID *_NoName routines (0xFA8421..0xFA8C30) and FDemoText_ByteData_DisplayRefresh_Skip@0xF8520e send GetName 0x01E00015 to 0x01A00000+n to print "idi%s%d".

Each case sends 0x01C00001 to an entry of the title's own view table (0x009A0006, 0x009B000F, 0x009C000E, ...), which presses that page's execute widget.

Sender: MainTitle_InitGraphicsAndEvents@0xF9800F (main_title_ctrl_panel.s:37) posts mode 0x01800001 and then 0x01C00016 with this title through PostEvent. Checks: BitMapOut_DecrementTimer@0xFB42A1 (bitmap_out_routines.s:284) holds the timer at its default while on this title; GroupBox_SndCmd_GetTitle@0xF99B7A (ui_control_panel.s:3627).

name: TITLE_SOFTVER
meaning: Title id 0xF0, "TT_SOFTVER": the software-version screen, requested by a control-panel switch chord.
evidence: Registration: InitializeMurai@0xF7AD77, drawbar_panel_ui.s:4557. Sender: CtrlPanel_PostScrollEvent@0xF982F3 (main_title_ctrl_panel.s:274) posts 0x01C00016 with it through ApPostEvent. The label name is misleading. Agrees with event-codes.md (accumulator 0xA1).

name: TITLE_TEST1
meaning: Title id 0xF4, "TT_TEST1": the first self-test screen. It is shown when the SRAM test or the panel-detection check reports a problem, and an entry of its view table Toshi_Viewable_TEST1 is then activated.
evidence: Registration: InitializeToshi@0xFC311A, extension_init.s:194; view table Toshi_Viewable_TEST1 at :145. Senders: SelfTest_SramAndRom@0xFB77D4 posts this title when Test_SRAM_IC21 returns non-zero, then 0x01C00001 to view 0x00F40001 (ui_mode_handlers.s:1654). SelfTest_SramAndRom_CheckROM@0xFB7824 posts it when CPanel_PanelDetection_Wrapper flags are set, then 0x01C00001 to view 0x00F40007 (:1691). Both use DeleteEvent followed by ApPostEvent 0x01C00016.

name: TITLE_TEST3
meaning: Title id 0xF6, "TT_TEST3": a self-test screen. While it is up, some panel handlers stand down and one is active only there.
evidence: Registration: InitializeToshi@0xFC311A, extension_init.s:196 (view class 0x01420011); view table Toshi_Viewable_TEST3 at :149. Checks: BitMapOut_ByteData_RenderA@0xFB4016 (bitmap_out_routines.s:72) and BitMapOut_ByteData_RenderB@0xFB40B7 (:121) return early on this title. BitmapFinpic_ByteData@0xFB7E14 (ui_mode_handlers.s:2340) runs only on this title and posts 0x01C0000B.

name: EVT_ACCORDION_TAB
meaning: Accordion tab selected. Firmware name EV_ACCORDIONTAB: entry 0 of the Murai ResEvent table, slot 0x1C1, table 0xE812E4. IvAccordion treats it like 0x01C00029 (root EV_IAMSELECTED).
evidence: Handler: IvAccordionProc 0xF7E250 does `cp xbc,0x1c10000` and jumps to IvAccordion_PageSelect 0xF7E4AA, the same case as 0x01C00029. Sender: AccordionX_PageSelect 0xF7E67F does PostEvent(-1, 0x01C10000, param) when the low word of the param is 1. The name string is at 0xE81394, and the table is the same in v10, v9 and v7.

name: EVT_READ_PRESENTATION
meaning: The presentation (Feature Demo) file has been read. The parameter is the loader's result (sign-extended; negative means it failed). Firmware name EV_READPRESENTATION, slot 0x1C1 entry 1.
evidence: Sender: MainPreControl 0xF865FB handles method 0x01E10003 (MT_ReadPresentation) through its 11-entry table Presentation_TagStrTable_0x72 0xEA007A. That case is FDemo_DisplayCtrlJumpHandler 0xF8662F: it calls Seq_LoadDisplayResource 0xF86360, then ApPostEvent(-1, 0x01C10001, result). Handler: ApPreControl 0xF86694 does `sub xwa,0x1c10001`, and its 7-entry table Presentation_TagStrTable_0x88 0xEA0090 sends entry 0 to Seq_StartWithFullInit+0x7 (0xF86710). That code stores the result at 0x025B7C and, if the result is >=0, runs FDemoText_ProcessTextMarkup.

name: EVT_READ_ACTION
meaning: The presentation's action file has been read. The parameter is the result. Firmware name EV_READACTION, slot 0x1C1 entry 2.
evidence: Sender: MainPreControl 0xF865FB, method 0x01E10004 (MT_ReadAction), goes to FDemo_DisplayCtrlJumpHandler+0x2A. That stub calls Seq_LoadNamedResource 0xF863E4, then FDemo_DispatchEventPost 0xF8666C does ApPostEvent(-1, 0x01C10002, result). Handler: entry 1 of ApPreControl 0xF86694's table goes to Seq_StartWithFullInit+0x64 (0xF8676D). It stores the result and, if the result is >=0, calls MainFuncCall(0x01410000, 0x01E10006 = MT_StartPresentation).

name: EVT_READ_SONG
meaning: The presentation's song file has been read. The parameter is the result. Firmware name EV_READSONG, slot 0x1C1 entry 3.
evidence: Sender: MainPreControl 0xF865FB, method 0x01E10005 (MT_ReadSong), goes to FDemo_DisplayCtrlJumpHandler+0x15. That stub calls FDemo_DisplayResourceData 0xF864A0, then ApPostEvent(-1, 0x01C10003, result). Handler: entry 2 of ApPreControl 0xF86694's table goes to Seq_StartWithFullInit+0x1C (0xF86725). It stores the result, copies the name at 0x4878 into a Malloc'd string, then calls MainFuncCall(0x01410000, 0x01E10004 = MT_ReadAction).

name: EVT_ALL_INITIAL
meaning: Opens the "AllInitial" screen, i.e. view 0x00EF0004 (ResName slot 0x3EF entry 4). The welcome screen posts it when the Sub-CPU payload error flag is negative. Firmware name EV_ALLINITIAL, slot 0x1C1 entry 4.
evidence: Sender: on EV_SHOW (0x01C00001), AcWelcomScreenProc 0xF7F4A6 calls SubCPU_Payload_GetErrorFlag 0xEF0979; when it returns <0 it does PostEvent(-1, 0x01C10004, 0). Handler: in AcWelcomScreenProc, `cp xiz,0x1c10004` goes to AcWelcomScreen_SubCpuError 0xF7FA01, which does SendEvent(0x00EF0004 'AllInitial', 0x01C00001, 3). ApPreControl's table entry 3 ignores it (ApPreControl_ReturnNull).

name: EVT_START_SONG
meaning: A presentation/demo song has started. The parameter is the demo song index, byte 0x28A4. Firmware name EV_STARTSONG, slot 0x1C1 entry 5.
evidence: Sender: Seq_DispatchEventType5 0xF8469B does ApPostEvent(-1, 0x01C10005, wa). It is called from the demo start path in file_demo_proc.s:870, after Seq_DispatcherEntry and SeqTimer_UpdateTempoReg. FDemoText_TextDispatch_Skip3 0xF857E1 also sends it, with param 19. Handlers: AcPresentationBoxProc 0xF842B4 goes to PresBox_TimerExpired 0xF84408, which sends 0x01C0001B (EV_INDEXSELECT) if the param matches the box's song. AcPresentationControlProc 0xF8450B goes to AcPresCtrl_Case4 0xF845D8, which calls ApFuncCall 0x01210028. ApPreControl table entry 4 goes to Seq_StartWithFullInit+0x7C (0xF86785), which hides view 0x00EE0016 'PleaseWait' (EV_HIDE) and posts 0x01C0000A (EV_ALLPAINT).

name: EVT_END_SONG
meaning: A presentation/demo song has ended. The parameter is the demo song index, byte 0x28A4. Firmware name EV_ENDSONG, slot 0x1C1 entry 6.
evidence: Sender: Seq_DispatchEventType6 0xF846AD does ApPostEvent(-1, 0x01C10006, wa). It is called from Demo_SelectEntry_AfterSongLoad 0xF86C5F, Demo_SelectEntry_StartAutoPlay 0xF86BCA and file_demo_proc.s:686. Handlers: AcPresentationBoxProc 0xF842B4 goes to PresBox_TimerTick 0xF8445A, which sends EV_INDEXSELECT if the song matches. AcPresentationControlProc 0xF8450B goes to AcPresCtrl_Case5 0xF845F6, which calls ApFuncCall 0x01210028 and ChangePalette(2), then shows object 0x00E40000. ApPreControl table entry 5 ignores it.

name: EVT_EXEC_PRESENTATION
meaning: Run a presentation. The parameter is a pointer to the presentation name: 0x00EA009E, which holds "FEATURE ". Firmware name EV_EXECPRESENTATION, slot 0x1C1 entry 7.
evidence: Sender: FDemo_LoadRegsAndPostEvent 0xF8681C does ApPostEvent(-1, 0x01C10007, 0x00EA009E). It is reached by `jp` from FileIO_ErrorCodeByteBlock 0xF8B4CC when FileIO_CheckFileExists succeeds (file_demo_proc.s:8909). Handler: entry 6 of ApPreControl 0xF86694's table goes to Seq_StartWithFullInit 0xF86709, which calls Seq_InitializeAndStart 0xF8630D with the param.

name: EVT_TONE_MODE
meaning: Reports a part's tone mode. Parameter = (part << 16) + the mode from FDemoText_CheckVoiceState (0, 1 or 2). Firmware name EV_TONEMODE, slot 0x1C1 entry 8.
evidence: Sender: MainMemDrawControl 0xF83BDA, method 0x01E1000E (MT_GetToneMode), goes to MemDraw_CheckVoiceState 0xF83CBD, which does ApPostEvent(-1, 0x01C10008, part<<16 + mode). Handler: AcDrawbarNameProc 0xF82B06 goes to AcDrawbarName_DrawbarInit 0xF82D0B. It compares the high word with the view's part (+36) and, when the mode is 1, opens the editor with MainFuncCall 0x01400004/0x01E0005E.

name: EVT_MP_VERSION
meaning: Opens the "MPVersion" screen, i.e. view 0x00EF0007. The welcome screen posts it when the boot button-combo code is 2. Firmware name EV_MPVERSION, slot 0x1C1 entry 9.
evidence: Sender: on EV_SHOW, AcWelcomScreenProc 0xF7F4A6 calls Boot_GetButtonComboCode 0xEF0651; when it returns 2 it does PostEvent(-1, 0x01C10009, 0). Handler: in AcWelcomScreenProc, `cp xiz,0x1c10009` goes to AcWelcomScreen_SubCpuLoaded 0xF7FA1B, which does SendEvent(0x00EF0007 'MPVersion', 0x01C00001, 3).

name: EVT_CHORD_SHOW
meaning: Show or redraw the chord box. AcChordBox handles it exactly like EV_SHOW. Firmware name EV_CHORDSHOW: Toshi ResEvent slot 0x1C2 entry 0, table 0xED2D04 (Toshi_ResEvent_Table).
evidence: Handler: AcChordBoxProc 0xFC2FBB goes to AcChordBox_HandleInitOrSelect 0xFC2FED, the same case as 0x01C00001. Sender: BitMapOut_CheckDiskAndApply 0xFB4277 does ApPostEvent(-1, 0x01C20000, 0), except when mode byte 0x8D38 == 138.

name: EVT_CHORD_DSP
meaning: Display a new chord name. The parameter is the chord-name string the sender just built. Firmware name EV_CHORDDSP, slot 0x1C2 entry 1.
evidence: Sender: MainChordPre_AppendChordSuffix 0xFC30B2 (method MT_ChordPre 0x01E2000D) builds the name with Strcat, then does ApPostEvent(-1, 0x01C20001, xiz), followed by 0x01E00023. Handler: AcChordBoxProc 0xFC2FBB goes to AcChordBox_HandleChordUpdate 0xFC300A.

name: EVT_PMBK_NAME
meaning: Panel-memory bank name changed. The parameter is an 18-byte Malloc'd block holding the bank number and name; it is freed by the 0x01E00023 that follows. Firmware name EV_PMBKNAME, slot 0x1C2 entry 2.
evidence: Senders: MainPmGet 0xFC2AD9-ish, method 0x01E20010 (MT_PmBankName), goes to MainPmGet_HandleBankData 0xFC2AFE, which does ApPostEvent(-1, 0x01C20002, blk). BitMapOut_ByteData_RenderState_Skip6 0xFB60A9 and BitMapOut_ByteData_DisplayUpdate_Skip 0xFB6129 post it the same way. Handlers: AcPmBkEditBoxProc 0xFBDB3D goes to AcPmBkEdit_BankChanged 0xFBDBFC; PmBankScreenProc 0xFC1A22 goes to PmBank_BankChanged 0xFC1C6C.

name: EVT_PM_NAME
meaning: Panel-memory name changed. The parameter is a Malloc'd block with the name, SndParam 0x300 and a display widget. Firmware name EV_PMNAME, slot 0x1C2 entry 3.
evidence: Sender: MainPmGet, method 0x01E20012 (MT_PmName), goes to MainPmGet_HandleBankDisplay 0xFC2B61, which does ApPostEvent(-1, 0x01C20003, blk). Handler: AcPmBkEditBoxProc 0xFBDB3D goes to AcPmBkEdit_BankEdit 0xFBDC73.

name: EVT_FRT_PAGE_CHANGE
meaning: Page change for the window-page control. The parameter is the new page index (1 or 3). Firmware name EV_FRTPAGECHANGE, slot 0x1C2 entry 4. What 'FRT' stands for is not established.
evidence: Sender: IvWindowPgCtl_SetPageIndex 0xFBCE4C stores the page, then does SendEvent(-1, 0x01C20004, page) followed by MainFuncCall 0x01400001/0x01E000AB. Handler: IvPageOverWrProc 0xFBD022 goes to IvPageOverWr_PageSelect 0xFBD090.

name: EVT_SUBCT_SHOW
meaning: Show the sub-category grid for the music-style item now selected. Firmware name EV_SUBCTSHOW, slot 0x1C2 entry 5.
evidence: Senders: after each dial step (SetAutoInc), AcMstStyle1GridBoxProc_Evt1C00017 0xFB8BC6 and AcMstStyle1GridBoxProc_Evt1C00018 0xFB8CD2 do SendEvent(-1, 0x01C20005, 0), including their MstStyle_DialDown/DialUp sub-blocks. Handler: AcMstStyle1SubGridBoxProc 0xFB903D goes to MstStyle1Sub_HandleSubSelect 0xFB91E1.

name: EVT_PAGE_SET
meaning: Set the window page. The parameter is the page number (1, 3, 5 or 6). Firmware name EV_PAGESET, slot 0x1C2 entry 6.
evidence: Senders: BitMapOut_ByteData_TransitionSeq 0xFB42D4 posts pages 5, 6, 3 or 1 depending on panel bits 0xC07E/0xC07F and SndParam 192, using ApPostEvent. GmOnOff_GetBoundsRect 0xFBE15F sends page 3 and GmOnOff_SendHideEvent 0xFBE1D0 sends page 1, both with SendEvent. Handler: IvWindowPageControlProc 0xFBCDF1 goes to IvWindowPgCtl_PageChanged 0xFBCE8B.

name: EVT_TVARI_PAINT
meaning: Repaint the Variation screen. Firmware name EV_TVARIPAINT, slot 0x1C2 entry 7. What the 'T' prefix means is not established.
evidence: Senders: BitMapOut_ByteData_RenderB_Skip2 0xFB413D first does DeleteEvent(-1, 0x01C20007), then ApPostEvent(-1, 0x01C20007, 0). BitMapOut_ByteData_RenderD_Skip2 0xFB41D5 does the ApPostEvent. Handler: VariScreenProc 0xFBE1E7 goes to VariScreen_RefreshAfterInit 0xFBE259.

name: EVT_NOT_PARA_DRAW
meaning: Suspend (param 1) or resume (param 0) parameter drawing. Each receiving view sets its draw-enable word to (param == 0). Senders post 1 before opening a modal file/password dialog and 0 after closing it, then post EV_ALLPAINT. Firmware name EV_NOTPARADRAW: Cheap ResEvent slot 0x1C5 entry 0, table 0xEA1188.
evidence: Handlers: PsFileNameBoxProc 0xF95557 goes to PsFileNameBox_HandleCancelState 0xF95A50 (view word +50). AcParaStrBoxProc 0xF95B2A goes to AcParaStrBox_HandleInit 0xF95BD7 (+40). AcFileSfxBoxProc 0xF95DD6 goes to AcFileSfx_HandleInit 0xF95F28 (+30). AcRotStrBoxProc 0xF967E8 goes to Scrollbar_Case1C00001 0xF96922 (+44). Senders posting 1 before showing DiskSaveSureWin 0x00600037, DiskDeleteSureWin 0x007B0051 or PasswordWin 0x00600040: FileName_OpLoad_NoPwd 0xF8CD65, FileName_OpDelete 0xF8CE82, SeqName_CheckDiskAvail 0xF91B4A, WakeUp_HandleOk 0xF94C85, WakeUp_StoreType 0xF94CEA. Senders posting 0 after the dialog closes: PwdOk_HandleConfirm 0xF94D50, PasswordNo 0xF94E84, DeleteYes 0xF94F3E. There are 38 sites in total.

name: EVT_NOT_POST_AIC
meaning: Suspend (param 1) or resume (param 0) the forwarding of the index-switch auto-repeat (AIC) events 0x01C00019/0x01C0001A as EV_INDEXSW_UP/DOWN while a file list is being redrawn. Firmware name EV_NOTPOSTAIC, slot 0x1C5 entry 1.
evidence: Handler: PsFileNameBoxProc 0xF95557 goes to PsFileNameBox_HandleOkState 0xF95A80, which sets view word +54 = (param == 0). That word gates PsFileNameBox_HandleScrollDone's MainFuncCall of 0x01C00017/0x01C00018. Senders: WPLoad_HandleScroll 0xF8EAE9 (param 1) and WPLoad_SendState 0xF8EC9E (param 0). SmfFN_NavSetup 0xF8E134 (1) and SmfFN_SendOkState 0xF8E85B (0).

name: EVT_INDEXSW_UP_DIAL
meaning: Index-switch step coming from the data dial, which is bound to the control with SetDialUp/SetDialDown. The control re-sends it as EV_INDEXSW_UP (0x01C00017) when the index is in range. Firmware name EV_INDEXSW_UP_D, slot 0x1C5 entry 2.
evidence: Binding (sender): Slider_AtMax 0xF966CD and Slider_Decrement 0xF966FB call SetDialUp/SetDialDown with 0x01C50003/0x01C50002, with the direction swapped by view flag +28. Handler: IvIndexSwCtrlProc 0xF965CE goes to Slider_Event1E00068 0xF9677B. That routine checks +22 <= param <= +24 and +26 != 0, then does SendEvent(-1, 0x01C00017, param) for 0x01C50002, else 0x01C00018.

name: EVT_INDEXSW_DOWN_DIAL
meaning: The dial-bound counterpart of 0x01C50002, re-sent as EV_INDEXSW_DOWN (0x01C00018). Firmware name EV_INDEXSW_DOWN_D, slot 0x1C5 entry 3.
evidence: Binding: Slider_AtMax 0xF966CD (SetDialUp) and Slider_Decrement 0xF966FB (SetDialDown). Handler: IvIndexSwCtrlProc 0xF965CE goes to Slider_Event1E00068 0xF9677B, which sends 0x01C00018.

name: EVT_WAKEUP_PASSWORD
meaning: Start the password check before a protected load, save or play. The parameter is the operation/slot byte at 0x8A0C (or 1). Firmware name EV_WAKEUPPASSWORD, slot 0x1C5 entry 4.
evidence: Senders, when SelectPasswordMode or the song-slot protect bit says a password is needed: FileName_OpLoad 0xF8CD39, SaveFilter_OpSave 0xF8D9A3 and SeqName_HandlePlayAction 0xF91B17, all ApPostEvent(-1, 0x01C50004, e). Handler: WakeUpPassword 0xF94C15 goes to WakeUp_StoreType 0xF94CEA. It stores the param at 0x02748E, posts EV_NOT_PARA_DRAW(1), then posts EV_SHOW to CheckPasswordWin 0x00600045.

name: EVT_CUR_SONG_NAME
meaning: The current-song name string has been fetched into RAM (0x1C50); redraw it. Firmware name EV_CURSONGNAME: Yoko ResEvent slot 0x1C7 entry 0, table 0xE20CB0.
evidence: Sender: NameGetFuncCall 0xF2154C, method 0x01E7000D (MT_GetCurSongName), table SepaOut_Config_0_0x13A 0xE20120 entry 0, goes to NameGetFuncCall_Dispatch 0xF21578. It formats the name with Sprintf, then does ApPostEvent(-1, 0x01C70000, 0). Handler: AcCurSongNameBoxProc 0xF2CB6F goes to AcCurSongName_HandleEventF 0xF2CBCB, which copies the string and sends EV_PARADRAW (0x01C0000F) to itself.

name: EVT_DISK_FILE_NAME
meaning: The disk file name has been fetched; redraw it. Firmware name EV_DISKFILENAME, slot 0x1C7 entry 1.
evidence: Sender: NameGetFuncCall 0xF2154C, method 0x01E7000E (MT_GetDiskFileName), goes to NameGetFuncCall_Dispatch+0x48, which does ApPostEvent(-1, 0x01C70001, 0). Handler: AcDiskFileNameBoxProc 0xF2B6D0 goes to AcDiskFileName_HandleEventF.

name: EVT_SMF_FILE_NAME
meaning: The SMF file name has been fetched; redraw it. Firmware name EV_SMFFILENAME, slot 0x1C7 entry 2.
evidence: Sender: NameGetFuncCall, method 0x01E7000F (MT_GetSmfFileName), goes to NameGetFuncCall_Dispatch+0x81, which does ApPostEvent(-1, 0x01C70002, 0). Handler: AcSmfFileNameBoxProc 0xF2B777 goes to AcSmfFileName_HandleEventF.

name: EVT_SMF_SONG_NAME
meaning: The SMF song name has been fetched; redraw it. Firmware name EV_SMFSONGNAME, slot 0x1C7 entry 3.
evidence: Sender: NameGetFuncCall, method 0x01E70010 (MT_GetSmfSongName), goes to NameGetFuncCall_Dispatch+0xC1 / NameGetFuncCall_Skip2, which does ApPostEvent(-1, 0x01C70003, 0). Handler: AcSmfSongNameBoxProc 0xF2B81E goes to AcSmfSongName_HandleEventF.

name: EVT_DOC_SONG_NAME
meaning: The song name of a document file (DOC) has been fetched; redraw it. Firmware name EV_DOCSONGNAME, slot 0x1C7 entry 5.
evidence: Sender: NameGetFuncCall, method 0x01E70012 (MT_GetDocSongName), goes to NameGetFuncCall_Skip2+0x41, which does ApPostEvent(-1, 0x01C70005, 0). Handler: AcDocSongNameBoxProc 0xF2B8C5 goes to AcDocSongName_HandleEventF.

name: EVT_DOC_FILE_NO
meaning: The file number of a document file (DOC) has been formatted; redraw it. Firmware name EV_DOCFILENO, slot 0x1C7 entry 6.
evidence: Sender: NameGetFuncCall, method 0x01E70013 (MT_GetDocFileNo), goes to NameGetFuncCall_Skip2+0x13. It does Sprintf, then ApPostEvent(-1, 0x01C70006, 0). Handler: AcDocFileNoBoxProc 0xF2B96C goes to AcDocFileNo_HandleEventF.

name: EVT_PD_SONG_NAME
meaning: The song name for 'PD' has been fetched; redraw it. Firmware name EV_PDSONGNAME, slot 0x1C7 entry 7. What 'PD' stands for is not established.
evidence: Sender: NameGetFuncCall, method 0x01E70014 (MT_GetPDSongName), goes to NameGetFuncCall_Skip3+0x41, which does ApPostEvent(-1, 0x01C70007, 0). Handler: AcPDSongNameBoxProc 0xF2BA13 goes to AcPDSongName_HandleEventF.

name: EVT_PD_FILE_NO
meaning: The 'PD' file number has been formatted; redraw it. Firmware name EV_PDFILENO, slot 0x1C7 entry 8.
evidence: Sender: NameGetFuncCall, method 0x01E70015 (MT_GetPDFileNo), goes to NameGetFuncCall_Skip3+0x13, which does ApPostEvent(-1, 0x01C70008, 0). Handler: AcPDFileNoBoxProc 0xF2BABA goes to AcPDFileNo_HandleEventF.

name: EVT_LYRICS_ALL_CLEAR
meaning: Clear the lyric display when song playback is aborted. The lyric box blanks its line buffers at 0x020CBE and, on titles 0x01A00072/0x01A00076, sends EV_DRAW. Firmware name EV_ALLCLEAR, slot 0x1C7 entry 9.
evidence: Senders, all ApPostEvent(0x006F0026 'Lyrics', 0x01C70009, 0) right after Song_AbortPlayback: PlayMode_SendStopEvent 0xF22B27, PlayMode_CheckAndAbort 0xF22B9C, CDlikeSwTtl_SongBit1Check/SongBit0Check/SongNavDispatch, DpSmfTtl_Dispatch, SqTrSel_CaseE. Handler: LyricsBoxProc 0xF2AA32 goes to LyricsBox_HandleEvent9 0xF2AA72. SongNameBoxProc 0xF2B3C5 and ComporserNameBoxProc 0xF2B4B4 also accept it, but no sender found targets them.

name: EVT_LYRICS_ALL_DRAW
meaning: Redraw every lyric line in the lyric box. Firmware name EV_ALLDRAW, slot 0x1C7 entry 10. It is distinct from the HD-AE5000's EV_Alldraw (0x01CA0008).
evidence: Senders: the DpSmfLyrTtl_Dispatch 0xF2210E and DpMdlySmfLyrTtlFunc title functions do ApPostEvent(0x006F0026 'Lyrics', 0x01C7000A, 0). Handler: LyricsBoxProc 0xF2AA32 goes to LyricsBox_HandleEventA 0xF2AABB, whose LyricsBox_DrawLineLoop draws every line.

name: EVT_LYRICS_RENEW
meaning: Draw the lyric text that has just been added (cursor range 0x020E46-0x020E4A) after a character or newline is entered. Firmware name EV_RENEW, slot 0x1C7 entry 11.
evidence: Senders: SongEdit_CheckBounds, SongEdit_OverflowCheck 0xF2AEE6, LyricsTrack_HandleSingleChar, LyricsBoxFunc_HandleNewline 0xF2B2E7, LyricsBoxFunc_HandleSingleChar and LyricsBoxFunc_HandleNormalChar, all SendEvent(0x006F0027 'LyricsData', 0x01C7000B, 0). Handler: LyricsBoxProc 0xF2AA32 goes to LyricsBox_HandleEventB 0xF2AC6C.

name: EVT_LYRICS_REVERSE
meaning: Redraw the highlighted lyric span (cursor range 0x020E3E-0x020E42) in reverse video. Firmware name EV_REVERSE, slot 0x1C7 entry 12.
evidence: Sender: LyricsFile_InsertNormalChar 0xF2B18D does SendEvent(0x006F0027, 0x01C7000C, 0), then UpdateScreen. Handler: LyricsBoxProc 0xF2AA32 goes to LyricsBox_HandleEventC 0xF2AD36.

name: EVT_LYRICS_SCROLL_UP
meaning: Scroll the lyric box up by one 18-pixel (0x12) line. Firmware name EV_SCROLLUP, slot 0x1C7 entry 13.
evidence: Sender: LyricsTrack_ZeroFillLoop 0xF2B0BC does SendEvent(0x006F0027, 0x01C7000D, 0) after it decrements the line count. Handler: LyricsBoxProc 0xF2AA32 goes to LyricsBox_HandleEventD 0xF2AE01, which blits the client box up by 0x12.

name: EVT_COMPOSER_WRITE
meaning: The composer name has been fetched (to RAM 0x021064); draw it. Firmware name EV_COMPORSERWRITE, with the firmware's spelling; the class label is ComporserNameBoxProc. Slot 0x1C7 entry 14.
evidence: Sender: NameGetFuncCall, method 0x01E7001A (MT_GetComporserName), goes to NameGetFuncCall_Skip5+0x12 / NameGetFuncCall_Join, which does ApPostEvent(-1, 0x01C7000E, 0). Handler: ComporserNameBoxProc 0xF2B4B4 goes to ComposerBox_HandleEventE 0xF2B539.

name: EVT_SONG_WRITE
meaning: The lyrics song name has been fetched; draw it, centred. Firmware name EV_SONGWRITE, slot 0x1C7 entry 15.
evidence: Sender: NameGetFuncCall, method 0x01E70019 (MT_GetLyricsSongName), goes to NameGetFuncCall_Skip4+0x13, which does ApPostEvent(-1, 0x01C7000F, 0). Handler: SongNameBoxProc 0xF2B3C5 goes to SongNameBox_HandleEventF 0xF2B44A.

name: EVT_LYRICS_PLAY_START_INI
meaning: Initialise the lyric player at song start: reset the four lyric cursors (0x020E3E/42/46/4A) and the text buffer. Firmware name EV_PlayStartIni, slot 0x1C7 entry 16.
evidence: Sender: CDlikeSwTtl_ShowSongTitle 0xF21867 does ApPostEvent(0x00720006 'LyricsFunc', 0x01C70010, 0) when SeqState bit 0 is clear. Handler: LyricsBoxFuncProc 0xF2B20A goes to LyricsBoxFunc_ResetCursors 0xF2B266.

name: EVT_LYRICS_PLAY_REQUEST
meaning: Lyric text arrived during playback and needs processing. LyricsFunc answers by sending itself EV_GetEvent (0x01C70012). Firmware name EV_PlayRequest, slot 0x1C7 entry 17.
evidence: Senders: Audio_SendEventPostCmd 0xF2AA02 and Audio_ExternalCallback 0xF2AA12 (both misnamed) do ApPostEvent(0x00720006 'LyricsFunc', 0x01C70011, 0). They are called from the SMF event decoder after it writes the lyric/sysex ring buffer: DecodeMidiEvent_Send 0xFECD39, ConfigureBanks_Send 0xFEC887 and SeqFile_ParseHeader_Block3. Handler: LyricsBoxFuncProc 0xF2B20A goes to LyricsBoxFunc_SendEvent12 0xF2B2AA.

name: EVT_LYRICS_GET_EVENT
meaning: Read the pending lyric text at 0x020E4E and apply it: newline, CR or characters, which in turn send EV_RENEW, EV_REVERSE or EV_SCROLLUP to LyricsData. Firmware name EV_GetEvent, slot 0x1C7 entry 18.
evidence: Sender: LyricsBoxFunc_SendEvent12 0xF2B2AA does SendEvent(0x00720006, 0x01C70012, 0) in response to EV_PlayRequest. Handler: LyricsBoxFuncProc 0xF2B20A goes to LyricsBoxFunc_HandleInput 0xF2B2BD.

name: EVT_LYRICS_CHANGE_COLOR
meaning: Lyric colour-change (highlight) data arrived: validate the lyric record at 0x020F4E and insert it. Firmware name EV_ChangeColor, slot 0x1C7 entry 19.
evidence: Sender: Audio_ExternalCallback 0xF2AA12 posts EV_PlayRequest, then ApPostEvent(0x00720006, 0x01C70013, 0), after SeqFile_ParseHeader (note_voice_mapping.s:20792). Handler: LyricsBoxFuncProc 0xF2B20A goes to LyricsBoxFunc_ValidateFile 0xF2B3B6, which runs LyricsFile_ValidateAndInsert 0xF2B122.

name: EVT_EFF_FIX_DRAW
meaning: Draw the fixed (non-parameter) area of an effect editor box. Firmware name EV_EFFFIXDRAW: Kubo ResEvent slot 0x1C8 entry 0, table 0xE27598.
evidence: Handlers: EffectBoxProc 0xF3344E goes to EffectBox_HandleScrollEvent 0xF33627 (misnamed), which draws the rectangle at (0x64,0x26) +0xB9 x +0x14. AccIllProc 0xF33137 goes to AccIll_HandleHorizSlider 0xF331DF (also a draw). Senders, in response to method 0x01E8000E (MT_RetEffFix): EffectBox_HandleEvent0 0xF335D9 and AccIll_HandleLowerPanelEvent 0xF331BA, both SendEvent(self, 0x01C80000, 0). EffectBox_RedrawAfterChange and EffectBox_RedrawFullLoop send it too.

name: EVT_EFF_PARA_DRAW
meaning: Draw effect parameter row N. The parameter is the row, 0-7. Firmware name EV_EFFPARADRAW, slot 0x1C8 entry 1.
evidence: Handlers: EffectBoxProc 0xF3344E goes to EffectBox_HandleSelectEvent 0xF339BF, which rejects a param >7 and draws at x=0xC3. AccIllProc 0xF33137 goes to AccIll_HandleVertSlider 0xF3329E. Senders: on method 0x01E8000F (MT_RetEffPara), EffectBox_HandleEvent1 0xF335E7 and AccIll_HandleUpperPanelEvent 0xF331C6. EffectBox_DrawAndSendLoop 0xF339A2, EffectBox_SendLoopValue and EffectBox_SendMultipleValues send rows 0-7.

name: EVT_EQ_LINE_DRAW
meaning: Draw the EQ curve/graph area (design box 0x20,0x24-0xF8,0x78). Firmware name EV_EQLINEDRAW, slot 0x1C8 entry 2.
evidence: Handler: EqualizerBoxProc 0xF33FB0 goes to Equalizer_HandleScrollUpEvent 0xF3425D (misnamed), which calls DrawDesignBox. Senders: on 0x01E8000E (MT_RetEffFix), Equalizer_SendPanelEvent 0xF34016 does SendEvent(self, 0x01C80002, 1). On 0x01E8000F, Equalizer_SendAndLoopDone sends it the same way.

name: EVT_EQ_STR_DRAW
meaning: Draw the value string of EQ band N. The parameter is the band, 0-7. Firmware name EV_EQSTRDRAW, slot 0x1C8 entry 3.
evidence: Handler: EqualizerBoxProc 0xF33FB0 goes to Equalizer_HandleSelectEvent 0xF34061, which rejects a param >7. Senders: Equalizer_SendChannelLoop 0xF34026 sends bands 0-7. Equalizer_SendAndLoopDone sends a single band.

name: EVT_GRAPH_DRAW
meaning: Redraw part N (0-14) of the note-edit graph. The parameter selects the part. Firmware name EV_GRAPHDRAW, slot 0x1C8 entry 4.
evidence: Senders: NoteEditSy_SendWidgetCmd0 0xF467E2 through NoteEditSy_SendWidgetCmd3or4 0xF4680F, NoteEditSy_UpdateNoteDisplay 0xF46983, NoteEditSy_GridPosFinish, NoteEditSy_UpdateEditModeGrid and others, all ApDeliveryEvent((0x2972), 0x01C80004, n). There are 13 sites in sequencer_engine.s. Handler: NoteEditBoxProc 0xF2F074 goes to NoteEditBox_GridDispatch2 0xF2F251, which dispatches param-3 (range 0-11) through table ExtDevice_ModeDispatch_Table_0x164.

name: EVT_HDAE_SEQ_STOP
meaning: The sequencer stopped while HD-AE5000 song-list (FLS) playback is active. FlsLoadScreen reacts by arming a 0x53-tick AP timer that later delivers 0x01CA0001. Firmware name EV_SeqStop: HD-AE5000 ResEvent slot 0x1CA entry 0, HDAE5000_EventName_Table 0x2F9772.
evidence: Senders: HDAE5000_Frame_Handler_Status 0x28F6E0 runs when bit 2 of the main CPU's sqsrtc falls and HDAE5000_Get_Status_Byte (0x22AD9A) is 1. On the HD title it does DeleteEvent and then ApPostEvent(HDAE5000_OBJ_FLS_FILE_LOAD_SW_EDIT, 0x01CA0000, 0). Otherwise it sets 0x22AD9B; later HDAE5000_HDAETitleFunc 0x283518 (case 8) posts it to HDAE5000_OBJ_FLS_FILE_LOAD. Handlers: HDAE5000_FlsLoadScreen 0x288822 (.LFWF_8896) calls SetApTimer(0x53, self, -1, 0, 0x01CA0001). HDAE5000_SelectListProc 0x2807D9 forwards it to its owner with MainFuncCall.

name: EVT_HDAE_AFTER_LOAD
meaning: Timer-delivered follow-up to EV_SeqStop. If FLS playback is still active (0x22AD9A == 1), FlsLoadScreen moves to the next FLS entry (list 0..0x77, item 0..0x1F) and loads it with HDAE5000_LoadSongWithUi. Firmware name EV_AfterLoad, slot 0x1CA entry 1.
evidence: Sender: the AP timer armed by HDAE5000_FlsLoadScreen 0x288822 (.LFWF_8896: push 0x01CA0001; RootFn_SetApTimer). Handlers: HDAE5000_FlsLoadScreen (.LFWF_88bf) calls HDAE5000_FlsItem_Get and HDAE5000_LoadSongWithUi 0x28AF38. HDAE5000_SelectListProc 0x2807D9 forwards it.

name: EVT_HDAE_TIMER_BACK
meaning: The error/attention message timer has expired; return to the screen that raised it. The catch object posts EV_SHOW to its owner, held in XDE. This is the event argument of every HD-AE5000 SetApTimer/KillApTimer pair with timer 0x14D. Firmware name EV_TimerBack, slot 0x1CA entry 2.
evidence: Senders (as the timer event argument): HDAE5000_LoadSongWithUi 0x28AF38, HDAE5000_SaveSongWithUi 0x28B0F1, HDAE5000_DirName_StoreWithUi 0x28AD48, HDAE5000_FlsName_StoreWithUi, HDAE5000_FlsEditScreen, HDAE5000_CopyToHd_Execute, HDAE5000_CopyToHDDirSelScreen, HDAE5000_AttenHDFormatSwCatch_Case6, HDAE5000_Lbn_TypeDigit. Handlers: HDAE5000_ErrMsgTimerCatch 0x28B403 and HDAE5000_ErrMsgTimerCatchLBN 0x28B48F do PostEvent(XDE, 0x01C00001, 0). HDAE5000_AttenHDFormatSwCatch 0x286666 (.LCHSC__ev_close). HDAE5000_SelectListProc 0x2807D9.

name: EVT_HDAE_INIT_LYRIC_PARAM
meaning: One-time layout set-up of the lyric box. The first time (flag 0x23A19A) it fetches the client box into 0x22A08C and insets it. Firmware name EV_INITLYRICPARAM, slot 0x1CA entry 3.
evidence: Sender: on EV_PAINT (0x01C0000B), HDAE5000_LyricBoxProc 0x28CD08 sends to itself 0x01CA0003, then 0x01CA0007, then 0x01CA0008(1). Handler: HDAE5000_LyricBoxProc's switch, HDAE5000_LyricBoxProc_CaseTable1 0x2E5BD2 entry 0, goes to HDAE5000_LyricBoxProc_Ev01CA0003 0x28CE19.

name: EVT_HDAE_TICKS
meaning: Song-position tick for the open lyric box. The parameter points to HDAE5000_RAM_LyricPosEvt (sqbtof, step, position); the box advances the lyrics to that position. Firmware name EV_TICKS, slot 0x1CA entry 4. The current constant EVT_DISPLAY_UPDATE is a misnomer.
evidence: Sender: HDAE5000_Frame_Handler 0x28F662 does ApPostEvent(HDAE5000_RAM_LyricBoxObj, 0x01CA0004, &LyricPosEvt) when (sq_beadt >> 3) + 1 changes. Handler: HDAE5000_LyricBoxProc_Ev01CA0004 0x28D41F calls HDAE5000_Lyrics_PlayToPosition 0x28D6D1, and on a new beat sends 0x01CA0005.

name: EVT_HDAE_BEAT_MESSAGE
meaning: Advance the beat/measure counters (beat 0x2307AC, measure 0x2307AA) and redraw the "%i/%i" beat display, via EV_Drawsyllable with param 3. Firmware name EV_BEATMESSAGE, slot 0x1CA entry 5.
evidence: Senders: HDAE5000_LyricBoxProc_Ev01CA0004 0x28D41F does SendEvent(LyricBoxObj, 0x01CA0005, 0) when the beat count reaches the beat length. HDAE5000_Lyrics_ReadSongInfo 0x28DBF8 sends it after it parses the time signature (the decimal operand 30015493). Handler: HDAE5000_LyricBoxProc_Ev01CA0005 0x28D47F.

name: EVT_HDAE_INIT_LYRICS
meaning: (Re)initialise the lyrics player for the loaded file. The parameter is 0 or 1. It runs HDAE5000_Lyrics_ResetState. Firmware name EV_Initlyrics, slot 0x1CA entry 7.
evidence: Senders: on EV_PAINT, HDAE5000_LyricBoxProc 0x28CD08 sends it with param 0. HDAE5000_LyricBoxProc_Case0_2 0x28D581 sends it with param 1. Handler: HDAE5000_LyricBoxProc_Ev01CA0007 0x28CF98 calls HDAE5000_Lyrics_ResetState 0x28DA7B.

name: EVT_HDAE_LYRIC_ALL_DRAW
meaning: Redraw all six lyric lines of the HD-AE5000 lyric box. Firmware name EV_Alldraw, slot 0x1CA entry 8. It is distinct from maincpu's EV_ALLDRAW (0x01C7000A).
evidence: Senders: HDAE5000_LyricBoxProc_Ev01C0000D 0x28CD6F (on EV_DRAW, param 0). The EV_PAINT case of HDAE5000_LyricBoxProc (param 1). HDAE5000_Lyrics_PlayToPosition 0x28D6D1. Handler: HDAE5000_LyricBoxProc_Ev01CA0008 0x28D034, which loops over the 6 lines.

name: EVT_HDAE_DRAW_SYLLABLE
meaning: Partial lyric-box redraw. The parameter (0-4) chooses the area: the sung syllable, the info line, the beat display (3), chord or reset (4). Firmware name EV_Drawsyllable, slot 0x1CA entry 9.
evidence: Senders: HDAE5000_Lyrics_PlayToPosition 0x28D6D1 (params 2 and others; the decimal operand 30015497). HDAE5000_LyricBoxProc_Ev01CA0005 0x28D47F (param 3). HDAE5000_LyricBoxProc_Ev01CA0008 0x28D034 (param 4). Handler: HDAE5000_LyricBoxProc_Ev01CA0009 0x28D2AA compares the param with 4, 3, 2, 1 and 0.

name: EVT_HDAE_DRAW_FD_TEXT
meaning: Draw the text of the floppy (FD) file-select box. Firmware name EV_DrawFDText, slot 0x1CA entry 12.
evidence: Sender: HDAE5000_FDFileSelectProc 0x28E61B, on EV_DRAW (0x01C0000D, .Lsc_case_0d), does SendEvent(self, 0x01CA000C, 0), then EV_PARADRAW. Handler: the same proc, `cp xwa,0x01ca000c` going to .Lsc_case_0c (the three-section text loop).

name: EVT_NONE
meaning: Null event (firmware EV_NONE). DeleteEvent cancels a queued event by overwriting its event field with this value in place; it is also the base of 0x01C0 range switches.
evidence: FW name table entry 0 (string @0xEAEBA8). Writers: DeleteEvent 0xFA9868 / GetEvent_ScanMatch 0xFA9893 store 0x1C00000 into the matching queue slot's event field (the same in DeleteSpecEvent/MainDeleteEvent/MainDeleteSpecEvent scan loops). Senders: MainTitle_EventLoop 0xF980A0 calls DirmdEmulator_Entry 0xF9AE97 with xbc=0x1C00000 as an idle no-event call; DirmdEmulator uses `sub xbc,0x1c00000` as its switch base.

name: EVT_SHOW
meaning: View shown (firmware EV_SHOW). Sent to a title's view after it becomes current; ViewableProc broadcasts it down the view tree. The param says why it was shown (0 = change, 3 = interrupt, 4 = return).
evidence: FW entry 1 (@0xEAEBA0). Handler: ViewableProc 0xFA5995 -> Viewable_InitClose 0xFA5ABE forwards SHOW/HIDE to the subview and then the next sibling. Senders: GroupBox_HandlePartChange 0xF99961 / GroupBox_HandleModeChange 0xF99A71 send EV_SHOW to the new title's view (from 0x1e00033) after the activation phases; GroupBox_HandleRefresh 0xF99DD2 sends param 4; the interrupt path sends param 3. Widget handlers initialise on it: PsFileNameBoxProc 0xF95557 (sets up dial up/down), DiskMedleyShowHideFunc 0xF95534, WaitingFunc 0xF954C4 (latches param). 186 cp / 267 ld sites.

name: EVT_HIDE
meaning: View hidden/closed (firmware EV_HIDE); broadcast down the view tree like EV_SHOW.
evidence: FW entry 2 (@0xEAEB98). Handler: ViewableProc 0xFA5995 -> Viewable_InitClose 0xFA5ABE (same broadcast as EV_SHOW); PsFileNameBoxProc -> PsFileNameBox_HandleClose; DiskMedleyShowHideFunc returns on HIDE. Senders: ApPostEvent with 0x1C00002 to a specific window when a dialog or progress window closes: FmmCmpLoad_CloseProgress / _HandleCancel / _HandleError / _HandleSuccess (single_load.s), FileName_OpSave / OpLoad_Execute / OpFormat / OpDelete_Execute (filename_password.s).

name: EVT_ACTION
meaning: Perform action N (firmware EV_ACTION); the param is an action/script index.
evidence: FW entry 6 (@0xEAEB74). Sender: AcPresentCtrl_CheckSSFStart 0xF84625 sends EV_ACTION with de = workspace+4 (action index) once the 0xB80A workspace tag matches. Handlers: AcPresentationControlProc_Evt1C00006 0xF84650; ApPreControl 0xF86694 -> FDemo_ProcessDisplayStateQuery 0xF867B2, which takes param 0..0x7F as an index into the table at 0x024FD8 and runs FDemoText_ProcessTextMarkup over that script.

name: EVT_SW_IN
meaning: Panel switch input (firmware EV_SWIN): the general press event for a switch, param = switch number (bit 7 = second bank). Posted on every press, with any still-queued copy cancelled first.
evidence: FW entry 7 (@0xEAEB6C). Senders: SndParam_SendDiskMenuEvents 0xF9816F / CtrlPanel_ProcessButtonPress 0xF98207 (control-panel 0xA9 packet, rising bit): DeleteSpecificEvent(EV_SWIN) then ApPostEvent(-1, EV_SWIN, switch#), right after EV_SWON. Handler: GroupBoxProc 0xF9983F table case (0xF9A101) forwards to BoxProc, then for an IvMainEditSw re-sends EV_SEND_SW_IN; SetAutoInc 0xF9A5BD accepts it as an auto-repeat root event; 184 widget/title cp sites treat it as the OK/press action (e.g. AcIndexEditSwProc -> AcIndexEdit_OK, the HD-AE5000 *SwCatch procs). Purged by RefreshApTask 0xF98877 / RefreshSwEvent 0xF98926.

name: EVT_SW_ON
meaning: Panel switch pressed (firmware EV_SWON), param = switch number. Not specific to DISK MENU.
evidence: FW entry 8 (@0xEAEB64). Senders: SndParam_SendDiskMenuEvents 0xF9816F and CtrlPanel_ProcessButtonPress 0xF98207 ApPostEvent(-1, 0x1C00008, switch#) on the rising edge of a switch bit in the 0xA9 panel packet; IvMainEditSw_BtnCancel 0xFA1BF0 relays it to a child. Handler: GroupBoxProc case (0xF99FB8) re-sends EV_SEND_SW_ON for an IvMainEditSw; SetAutoInc root-event check; PanicFunc and PcgOutSendFunc act only on it; Dp*TtlFunc cases. Purged by RefreshSwEvent 0xF98926.

name: EVT_SW_OFF
meaning: Panel switch released (firmware EV_SWOFF), param = switch number.
evidence: FW entry 9 (@0xEAEB5A). Senders: CtrlPanel_CheckDiskMenuRelease 0xF981DC / CtrlPanel_CheckButtonRelease 0xF9827D ApPostEvent(-1, 0x1C00009) on the falling edge and clear the held-switch mask bit (0x02749A/0x02749E); AcIndexEdit_Reset 0xFA111C, AcMixerVol_Reset and GroupBox_CloseAll send synthetic releases. Handlers: GroupBoxProc case (0xF9A05B) -> EV_SEND_SW_OFF for IvMainEditSw; ScreenProc -> Screen_Deactivate; AcPanicEditSwProc. Purged by RefreshSwEvent.

name: EVT_ALL_PAINT
meaning: Repaint the whole screen (firmware EV_ALLPAINT), posted to the current target after a dialog or progress window closes.
evidence: FW entry 10 (@0xEAEB4E). Handler: GroupBoxProc table case (0xF99F4D) sends EV_PAINT to the root object and updates the screen; AcWelcomScreenProc 0xF7F4A6 -> AcWelcomScreen_Activate. Senders (all PostEvent/ApPostEvent to 0xFFFFFFFF, param 0): MainTitle_TeardownAndLoop 0xF9806C, UI_PostRefreshEvent 0xF994EA, GroupBox_SndCmd_PostRefreshEvent, the medley/disk dialog Yes/No handlers (DeleteYes, SaveYes, PasswordNo ...), IvExitWindow_OK.

name: EVT_PAINT
meaning: Paint a view and its subviews (firmware EV_PAINT): if visible, send EV_DRAW to self, then propagate EV_PAINT to the subview and next sibling.
evidence: FW entry 11 (@0xEAEB44). Handler: ViewableProc 0xFA5995 -> ViewableProc_Evt1C0000B 0xFA5AEE: GetVisible; SendEvent(self, 0x1C0000D EV_DRAW); then forwards the same event to View_GetSuperViewInstance and View_GetNextSibling. Senders: EV_ALL_PAINT case of GroupBoxProc; ViewableProc_Evt1C0000C (EV_REPAINT) sends EV_PAINT to the subview. 192 cp sites (e.g. WaitingFunc 0xF954C4 draws its message on it).

name: EVT_REPAINT
meaning: Repaint self after a data change (firmware EV_REPAINT): EV_DRAW to self, then EV_PAINT to subviews. Widgets refresh their displayed value on it.
evidence: FW entry 12 (@0xEAEB38). Handler: ViewableProc_Evt1C0000C 0xFA5B34: if visible, SendEvent(self, EV_DRAW) then SendEvent(subview, EV_PAINT). Widget handlers re-read their value and redraw, e.g. AcLswBoxProc 0xF9CE7E -> AcLswBox_HandleShowHide 0xF9CF2B (MainLswGet); many such cases carry `_ShowHide` labels. Senders: PsEditSwBox_Repaint, PsToggleBox_Repaint, CDlikeSwTtl_SetRecordAndNotify / SeqInit_PostEventSequence (after changing record state), CmpNcpTtl_Dispatch2 via ApDeliveryEvent.

name: EVT_DRAW
meaning: Draw this view only (firmware EV_DRAW); EV_PAINT and EV_REPAINT send it to self.
evidence: FW entry 13 (@0xEAEB30). Senders: ViewableProc_Evt1C0000B/C 0xFA5AEE/0xFA5B34 SendEvent(self, 0x1C0000D, 0). Handlers draw the widget: ModeEditProc 0xF9C12A -> ModeEdit_HandlePaint 0xF9C15B (draws the mode name), PsListBoxProc 0xF9D72E (draws the box, then sends itself EV_PARA_DRAW and EV_SELE_DRAW), HD-AE5000 HDAE5000_TtlScreenRProc 0x280489 (draws its bitmap via the 0x1E000A1 queries); ViewableProc returns 0 for it. 140 cp sites.

name: EVT_SELE_DRAW
meaning: Draw the selection highlight (firmware EV_SELEDRAW), param = the selected index.
evidence: FW entry 14 (@0xEAEB24). Handlers: PsListBoxProc 0xF9D72E -> PsListBox_Select 0xF9D903 (compares param with the current index and redraws the highlight); PsRadioBox/PsGridBox/PsCursorBox/PsTrackSwitch/PsEditBox *_Select; HDAE5000_AcHddNamingWindowProc 0x281411. Senders: PsListBox EV_DRAW case sends EV_SELE_DRAW with the stored index; PsListBox_Reset 0xF9DB43 (on EV_CHANGE_DIAL_FOCUS) re-sends it. ViewableProc returns 0.

name: EVT_PARA_DRAW
meaning: Draw the parameter/value text (firmware EV_PARADRAW); param = string pointer, or 0 to fetch the text with 0x1E0003A. Sibling event 0x01C50000 is EV_NOTPARADRAW.
evidence: FW entry 15 (@0xEAEB18). Handler: PsListBoxProc 0xF9D72E -> PsListBox_Confirm 0xF9D7BC: VwBoxProc, then Strcpy(param), or SendEvent(self, 0x1E0003A) when param is 0, and lays out the text; also PsLabel_Confirm, PsRadioBox/PsGridBox/PsTrkSw _Confirm, HDAE5000_SelectListProc. Senders: PsListBox EV_DRAW case (param 0); WaitingFunc 0xF954C4 (param = formatted message buffer); about 717 ld sites, including 36 decimal `ld xbc, 29360143` in sequencer_engine.s. ViewableProc returns 0.

name: EVT_CHANGE_PROPERTY
meaning: A property of the view changed (firmware EV_CHANGEPROPERTY); the receiver re-reads the changed property and updates its field.
evidence: FW entry 17 (@0xEAEAFC). Handlers: ModeEditProc 0xF9C12A -> ModeEdit_HandleViewUpdate 0xF9C1CA and TitleEditProc 0xF9C2BC -> TitleEdit_HandleViewUpdate: BoxProc, SendEvent(self, 0x1E00022, param), then compare the property id (0x58/0x6C/0x61/0x6A/0x60) and store the matching instance field; ViewableProc returns 0. No literal sender in v10/hdae operands.

name: EVT_ACTIVATE_STATE
meaning: Activation-state notification to a mode or title object (firmware EV_ACTIVATE). The param is a phase: 0 = mode activated, 1 = mode deactivated, 2 = title activated, 3 = title deactivated, 4 = title interrupted, 5 = title restored, 6 = activated as interrupt title, 7 = interrupt title closing, 8 = switch complete. Not a control-panel event.
evidence: FW entry 19 (@0xEAEAE6). Senders (GroupBoxProc 0xF9983F cases): GroupBox_HandlePartChange 0xF99961 (EV_CHANGE_MODE) sends 3 to TitleOld, 1 to ModeOld, 0 to ModeNow, 2 to TitleNow, then 8. GroupBox_HandleModeChange 0xF99A71 (EV_CHANGE_TITLE) sends 3 / 2 / 8. GroupBox_SndCmd_ProcessTitle 0xF99C4F (EV_INTERRUPT_TITLE) sends 4 to the old title, then 2 and 6 to the new one, then 8. GroupBox_HandleRefresh 0xF99DD2 (EV_RETURN_TITLE) sends 7 and 3 to the old title, 5 to the new one, then 8. Handlers: TitleProc 0xFA4E03 broadcasts EV_NEW_TITLE on phase 2 and EV_OLD_TITLE on phase 3, and on phase 8 copies ModeNow/TitleNow to ModeOld/TitleOld; FmmUtilityTitleFunc 0xF8B885 and the WPLoad title func start their disk operation on 2 and abort on 3 (WPLoad_HandleAbort 0xF8EA9B); ModeProc 0xFA4A6D case ObjectEnum_Default. Name suffixed _STATE because EVT_ACTIVATE is already taken (=0x01C00008).

name: EVT_CHANGE_MODE
meaning: Request a change of the current mode (firmware EV_CHANGE_MODE); param = mode id 0x0180nnnn.
evidence: FW entry 20 (@0xEAEAD6). Handlers: GroupBoxProc 0xF9983F -> GroupBox_HandlePartChange 0xF99961 (misnamed; runs the EV_ACTIVATE_STATE 3/1/0/2/8 sequence); ModeProc 0xFA4A6D -> ObjectEnum_Close 0xFA4BA7 (updates ModeNow/Old); MainTitleControl. Senders: UI_PostPartChangeEvent 0xF99463 (misnamed; DeleteEvent + ApPostEvent with 0x01800000+A); MainTitle_InitGraphicsAndEvents 0xF9800F (mode 0x01800001 at boot); GroupBox_HandleStateCompare 0xF99E57 (EV_SW_IN_MODE); HD-AE5000 HDAE5000_RequestMode 0x28AC1F.

name: EVT_CHANGE_TITLE
meaning: Request a change of the current title/screen (firmware EV_CHANGE_TITLE); param = title id 0x01A0nnnn.
evidence: FW entry 21 (@0xEAEAC6). Handlers: GroupBoxProc -> GroupBox_HandleModeChange 0xF99A71 (misnamed; first unwinds any interrupt title with EV_RETURN_TITLE, then sends EV_ACTIVATE_STATE 3 to the old title, 2 to the new, EV_SHOW, then 8); TitleProc 0xFA4E03 -> EventDispatch_SelectMatch 0xFA5020; MainTitleControl -> SeqState_TransitionMode. Senders: UI_PostModeChangeEvent 0xF99490 (misnamed), CtrlPanel_PostDisplayEvent (title 0x00), about 30 *_OK/*Exit procs posting 0x01A000xx, HDAE5000_RequestTitle15 0x28AC68.

name: EVT_INTERRUPT_TITLE
meaning: Show a title temporarily on top of the current one (firmware EV_INTERRUPT_TITLE), e.g. a message, error, welcome or software-version screen; param = title id. It is later unwound with EV_RETURN_TITLE. This is what separates it from EV_CHANGE_TITLE.
evidence: FW entry 22 (@0xEAEAB2). Handlers: GroupBoxProc -> GroupBox_HandleSoundCommand 0xF99B5F / GroupBox_SndCmd_ProcessTitle 0xF99C4F (old title gets EV_ACTIVATE_STATE 4 'interrupted' instead of 3, the new one 2 then 6); TitleProc 0xFA4E03 -> EventDispatch_OK 0xFA50B1 -> EventDispatch_DefaultProc 0xFA51CE, which calls SetInterruptTime. Senders: mostly title 0x01A000EE TT_MESAGE (MainFlashFunc, SetupExitFunc 0xF9514F, MainTimeFlashFunc, GMYesFunc ...); 0xEF TT_WELCOM at boot (MainTitle_InitGraphicsAndEvents 0xF9800F); 0xF0 TT_SOFTVER (CtrlPanel_PostScrollEvent); 0xF4 self-test error (SelfTest_SramAndRom); SoundCtrl_SendCommand 0xF994BD; HD-AE5000 HDAE5000_Boot_Init 0x28F576 (title 0x7F) and HDAE5000_ShowErrorMessageTitle 0x28ACFA.

name: EVT_INDEXSW_UP
meaning: Index/cursor up (firmware EV_INDEXSW_UP); the dial is bound to it with SetDialUp, and the panel index switches produce it too.
evidence: FW entry 23 (@0xEAEAA4). Senders: 116 SetDialUp/SetDialDown bindings (e.g. PsFileNameBoxProc 0xF95557 binds EV_INDEXSW_UP/DOWN to the dial; SetDialUp 0xF9A579); GroupBox_HandleCursorNav 0xF99F5A sends the bound event on an EV_DIAL. Handlers scroll or step: PsFileNameBox_HandleScrollEvt, AcGridBoxProc_Evt1C00017 0xF9EA1E (steps, then arms EV_INDEXSW_UP_AIC via SetAutoInc), WPLoad_HandleScroll.

name: EVT_INDEXSW_DOWN
meaning: Index/cursor down (firmware EV_INDEXSW_DOWN); the dial-down counterpart of EV_INDEXSW_UP.

name: EVT_GET_CLASS_SP
meaning: MT_GetClassSp. Asks an object table's proc for the class id of the object. SendEvent asks this of every target first, then calls that class's proc with the real event. ObjectProc uses it before forwarding object-level introspection. For a class-table entry the answer is the id itself; the other table procs return their fixed class.
evidence: Firmware name: ResMethod table 0x1E0, entry 0 (names at 0xEAEBB2, registered by InitializeRoot; identical in v7, v9 and v10). Handlers: ClassProc@0xFA44E2 case 0, ClassProc_Event_LoadFromWA@0xFA4598 (returns XWA); FunctionProc@0xFA48A9 via ResourceWidget_Init@0xFA490B (0x01600001); ApFunctionProc@0xFA496C (0x01600002); MainFunctionProc@0xFA4A18 (0x01600003); SupportClassProc@0xFA4836 (0x01600005); ModeProc@0xFA4A6D (0x01600006); TitleProc@0xFA4E03 via TitleProc_EventDispatch@0xFA4F76 (0x01600007); ResEventProc@0xFA58FB (0x0160000C); ResMethodProc@0xFA5948 (0x0160000D); ViewableProc@0xFA5995. Senders: SendEvent@0xFA9660 / EventRoute_ObjectDispatch@0xFA9679 (stores the result at 0x02BC14, then calls class record +0); ObjectProc@0xFA3D85; RootContext_Setup@0xFAA03A.

name: EVT_GET_PARENT_CLASS_SP
meaning: MT_GetParentClassSp. Class-level query that returns the parent class id (Class record +4 'parent').
evidence: Firmware name: ResMethod 0x1E0, entry 1. Handler: ClassProc@0xFA44E2 jump-table case 1, ClassProc_Event_LoadFromHL@0xFA459D (XHL = record+4 after `inc 4,xhl`; returns (XHL)). Sender: ObjectProc_Evt1E00011@0xFA3E02 (object-level MT_GetParentClass forwarded to the object's class).

name: EVT_GET_PROCEDURE_SP
meaning: MT_GetProcedureSp. Returns the class procedure pointer (Class record +0 'proc').
evidence: Firmware name: ResMethod 0x1E0, entry 2. Handler: ClassProc case 2, ClassProc_Event_LoadFromIZ@0xFA45A2 (XIZ = record; returns (XIZ)). Sender: ObjectProc_Evt1E00013@0xFA3E11 (MT_GetProcedure).

name: EVT_GET_INSTANCE_SIZE_SP
meaning: MT_GetInstanceSizeSp. Returns the instance size of the class (WORD at Class record +8 'allsize'). Not *(XHL+0x0C), as the existing comment says.
evidence: Firmware name: ResMethod 0x1E0, entry 3. Handler: ClassProc case 3, ClassProc_Evt1E00003@0xFA45B0 (`ld hl,(xiz+8); extz xhl`). Sender: ObjectProc_Evt1E00021@0xFA3E20 (MT_GetInstanceSize).

name: EVT_CHECK_CLASS_SP
meaning: MT_CheckClassSp. Class-level is-a test. Walks the parent chain from this class and returns 1 if it reaches the class id given in the parameter, otherwise 0.
evidence: Firmware name: ResMethod 0x1E0, entry 4. Handler: ClassProc_Evt1E00004@0xFA45B8 (loops through TitleWidget_Paint_CheckState / TitleWidget_Paint_DrawText, following record+4 until 0xFFFFFFFF). Sender: ObjectProc_Evt1E00014@0xFA3E3E (object-level MT_CheckClass).

name: EVT_GET_PROP_STRING_EX
meaning: MT_GetPropStringEx. Builds the full property-signature string (one type letter per field) into the caller's buffer, recursing to the parent class. Each of the class's own letters is first offered to its type object 0x02600000+(ch-'A') with MT_CheckPropString.
evidence: Firmware name: ResMethod 0x1E0, entry 5. Handler: ClassProc_Evt1E00005@0xFA4612 (Strcpy of propdata at record+16, loop in TitleWidget_Select, Strcat, then recursion to the parent with 0x01E00005). Senders: ObjectProc_Evt1E00019@0xFA3E4D (MT_GetPropString); TitleWidget_Confirm@0xFA463F (the parent recursion).

name: EVT_GET_PROP_COUNT_SP
meaning: MT_GetPropCountSp. Number of properties, computed as the strlen of the property string.
evidence: Firmware name: ResMethod 0x1E0, entry 6. Handler: ClassProc_Evt1E00006@0xFA469C (SendEvent MT_GetPropString, then Strlen). Sender: ObjectProc_Evt1E00017@0xFA3E96 (MT_GetPropCount).

name: EVT_GET_PROP_NAME_SP
meaning: MT_GetPropNameSp. Class-level lookup of the name of property #n (param = {index, buffer}). Recurses to the parent first, then walks the class's own propname list (record+20), counting the members of compound types through MT_GetPropMember.
evidence: Firmware name: ResMethod 0x1E0, entry 7. Handler: ClassProc_Evt1E00007@0xFA46B6. Senders: ObjectProc_Skip2@0xFA3EF3 (inside ObjectProc's MT_GetPropName case); ClassProc_Evt1E00007 itself (parent recursion).

name: EVT_COPY_PROPERTY_EX
meaning: MT_CopyPropertyEx. Type-object method (table 0x260, id 0x02600000+(typechar-'A')) that copies one property value. The pointer and string types handle it by allocating and duplicating the data.
evidence: Firmware name: ResMethod 0x1E0, entry 8. Handlers: pBoolProc@0xFA65A6 (Malloc plus IDCountHelper), pSwordProc@0xFA66E2 through pUlongProc@0xFA6D0E, StringProc@0xFA7A9A, CommonIDProc@0xFA9304 (switch whose base is 0x01E00008). Sender: ObjectProc_Evt1E0001A@0xFA3F0F (object-level MT_CopyProperty, sent to the property's type object).

name: EVT_DUMP_PROPERTY_EX
meaning: MT_DumpPropertyEx. Type-object method that reads one property value out of an instance record for a dump. Scalar types take the same path as MT_GetPropertyEx.
evidence: Firmware name: ResMethod 0x1E0, entry 9. Handlers: 46 type procs, e.g. swordProc@0xFA62EC (BoxStyle0_Setup: IDCursorAdvance, read sign-extended word into param), RectX1Proc@0xFA6EC8, NameProc@0xFA91B5, ConstFlagProc@0xFA923E. Sender: ObjectProc_Evt1E0001B@0xFA3F4B (MT_DumpProperty).

name: EVT_DUMP_POINTER_EX
meaning: MT_DumpPointerEx. Type-object method that dumps the data a pointer-typed property points to. Only the pointer types handle it.
evidence: Firmware name: ResMethod 0x1E0, entry 10. Handlers: pBoolProc@0xFA65A6, pSwordProc@0xFA66E2, pUwordProc@0xFA681E, pScharProc@0xFA695A, pUcharProc@0xFA6A98, pSlongProc@0xFA6BD4, pUlongProc@0xFA6D0E. Sender: ObjectProc_Evt1E0001C@0xFA3F89 (MT_DumpPointer).
