evidence: Firmware name: ResMethod 0x1E0, entry 122. Handler: TitleProc to EnumList_OK_Next@0xFA569C (`cpw (xhl+18),0xffff; scc nz`). Senders (23 sites): EventDispatch_SelectMatch@0xFA5020 (TitleProc's EV_CHANGE_TITLE case sends EV_RETURN_TITLE while the current title is an interrupt); ObjectEnum_Close@0xFA4BA7; IvExitMode_OK@0xFA1CCE; Screen_OK@0xF9A887.

name: EVT_SET_AP_FUNCTION
meaning: MT_SetApFunction. Gives a naming window the ApFunction id of its check function (the parameter).
evidence: Firmware name: ResMethod 0x1E0, entry 123. Handlers: AcNamingWindowProc@0xF9B3E3 (WndScroll_StoreCallerPtr); HDAE5000_AcHddNamingWindowProc@0x281411. Senders: IvNaming_Init@0xFA1F77 (SendEvent(0x0000000A, 0x01E0007B, view+22)); HD-AE5000 hd-ae5000_v2_06i.s:3705.

name: EVT_GET_STRING_LENGTH
meaning: MT_GetStringLength. The naming window asks its check ApFunction for the length of the name to edit; the window stores it at RAM 0x0274D6, capped at 32. NamingCheck answers with the Strlen of the default name.
evidence: Firmware name: ResMethod 0x1E0, entry 124. Handlers (20 sites): NamingCheck@0xFA1FCD (NamingCheck_GetStrLen: Strlen); TechnicsFileNaming@0xF951BA; PasswordOk@0xF94D18; SeqNamingCheck@0xF2CFE3; HDAE5000_HDDNamingCheck@0x284298. Senders: AcNaming_InitScrollState@0xF9B4BE (ApFuncCall on (0x0274D2)); HD-AE5000 .LRF_14eb.

name: EVT_RETURN_STRING
meaning: MT_ReturnString. Firmware name only; no use was found.
evidence: [not in worklist] Firmware name: ResMethod 0x1E0, entry 125. No literal occurrence in the v10 or HD-AE5000 ROM images.

name: EVT_REQUEST_STRING
meaning: MT_RequestString. Firmware name only; no use was found.
evidence: [not in worklist] Firmware name: ResMethod 0x1E0, entry 126. No literal occurrence in the v10 or HD-AE5000 ROM images.

name: EVT_SET_PAGE
meaning: MT_SetPage. Sets the current page (the parameter) of a paged box or window, including the naming window's character pages.
evidence: Firmware name: ResMethod 0x1E0, entry 127. Handlers: PsPageBoxProc@0xFA1323 (PsPageBox_SetValue); AcNamingWindowProc@0xF9B3E3 (WndScroll_HandleIndexChange); HDAE5000_AcHddNamingWindowProc@0x281411. Senders (27 sites): WndScroll_SendPageEvents@0xF9C003; TtSdmenu@0xF7B61E; HelpFuncChkFunc@0xF2E7DA; HDAE5000_AcWindowPage1Proc@0x28043C.

name: EVT_SET_CURSOR
meaning: Firmware method MT_SetCursor. The parameter is a cursor index, and the receiving box stores it as its cursor position. The naming window uses it to move the edit cursor in the name buffer.
evidence: Name: ResMethod table slot 0x1E0 (0xEAEBB2), entry 0x80 = "MT_SetCursor". Handlers: PsCursorBoxProc (0xfa3190) branches to PsCursorBox_SetCursor (0xfa33d3), which writes the parameter word to *(instance+36). AcNamingWindowProc (0xf9b3e3) branches to WndScroll_HandleCharInput (0xf9bec6), which stores the parameter at 0x274d8 and forwards SetCursor to object 0x16. Senders: WndScroll_HandleCharSet (0xf9c028) and WndScroll_CopyStringAndSend (0xf9be36) send the cursor index. HDAE5000_AcHddNamingWindowProc (0x281411) mirrors this.

name: EVT_SET_CHARA
meaning: Firmware method MT_SetChara. The parameter is a character code, and the naming window writes it into its name buffer at the current cursor position.
evidence: Name: entry 0x81 = "MT_SetChara". Handler: AcNamingWindowProc (0xf9b3e3) branches to WndScroll_HandleCharSet (0xf9c028), which stores the parameter byte at 0x274b0 plus the cursor (0x274d8) and then sends MT_SetCursor. Senders: WndScroll_ClampPageCount (0xf9c0a3) and WndScroll_CheckSPMarker (0xf9c0f2), on a character-picker choice. HDAE5000_AcHddNamingWindowProc (0x281411) handles it and sends it at .LRF_25ab/.LRF_261c.

name: EVT_RAM_DATA_REQ
meaning: Firmware method MT_RamData. A RAM-edit box sends it to its ApFunction after it writes a new value to the edited RAM variable. The parameter is the new value.
evidence: Name: entry 0x82 = "MT_RamData". Senders: AcRamEdit_Assign (0xf9fc63) gets the address with MT_GetRamAddress (0x01E00045), stores the value, then calls ApFuncCall(func, 0x01E00082, *addr). AcRamBox_HandleWriteBack (0xf9d13a) does the same. Handlers are the edit-check ApFunctions: RamEditCheck (0xf9fdd6) treats it as not handled, WallHomeEditCheck (0xfc2445) returns false, MspNameBnkFunc (0xf1c3fb) dispatches on it, and about 40 HD-AE5000 *Check functions handle it (for example HDAE5000_FileLBNNameCheck 0x287559).

name: EVT_LSW_DATA_REQ
meaning: Firmware method MT_LswData. This is the Lsw counterpart of MT_RamData: an Lsw parameter edit box sends it to its parameter function after writing a new value. The parameter is the new value.
evidence: Name: entry 0x83 = "MT_LswData". Senders: AcLswEdit_Match (0xf9f64f) gets the address with MT_GetLswAddress (0x01E00040), stores the word, then calls ApFuncCall(func, 0x01E00083, value). AcLswBox_HandleWriteBack (0xf9cf51), PsMixer_ArrayReadHandler (0xf8031c) and AcLswPartEdit_Match (0xf7be2b) also send it. Handlers: LswPercDecay (0xf82f9d) branches to LswPercDecay_StoreDE (0xf83041) and stores the value. LswPan (0xf7ce91), LswKeyShift (0xf7d40a), LswEditCheck (0xf9f82c) and others return 0.

name: EVT_GET_NAMING_MODE
meaning: Firmware method MT_GetNamingMode. The naming window asks its owner which naming mode (character set) to offer, and the answer is the mode index.
evidence: Name: entry 0x84 = "MT_GetNamingMode". Sender: AcNaming_QueryCharSet (0xf9b4ee) calls ApFuncCall(owner at 0x274d2, 0x01E00084), stores the result at 0x274e2, picks layout Data_SoundEditorCharsLayout_0x18[mode], and hides views 0x17-0x19 when the mode is not 0. Handlers: TechnicsFileNaming (0xf951ba) branches to TechnicsFileNaming_Validate (0xf951f8), which returns 1 (the label is a misnomer). NamingCheck (0xfa1fcd) returns 0. SmfFileNaming, FormatDiskNaming, HDAE5000_HDDNamingCheck (0x284298) and others also handle it.

name: EVT_ARE_YOU_CLASS_PROC
meaning: Firmware method MT_AreYouClassProc. It is a capability query sent to an object's callback before events are routed to it. A callback that returns 1 accepts the role.
evidence: Name: entry 0x85 = "MT_AreYouClassProc". Sender: IvCatchEvent_Lookup (0xfa2094) resolves the IvCatchEvent instance's callback id (+22) through registry 0x27edc, calls it with 0x01E00085, and branches on a non-zero answer. Handlers that return 1: DefaultClassProc (0xfa210e) through DefaultClass_ReturnOne (0xfa2129), RevSelFunc (0xf74391), EqSelFunc, WakeUpPassword (0xf94c15), HamaEvtDisp_Entry (0xf1e8ce), and the HD-AE5000 *SwCatch functions (for example HDAE5000_FlsDel1SwCatch 0x288fed).

name: EVT_SET_STRING
meaning: Firmware method MT_SetString. The parameter is a char pointer, and the call sets the object's text. The naming window copies it into its edit buffer, and file and disk-name functions apply it as the new name.
evidence: Name: entry 0x86 = "MT_SetString". Handlers: AcNamingWindowProc (0xf9b3e3) branches to WndScroll_CopyStringAndSend (0xf9be36). FileRenameFunc (0xf8be1c) branches to FRename_HandleApply (0xf8beb6), which copies 0x8870 into the file entry. DiskNameFunc, SaveFileNameFunc and HDAE5000_HDDNamingCheck (0x284298) handle it the same way. Senders: FRename_TextChange_SendApply (0xf8bea3) calls ApPostEvent(obj, 0x01E00086, 0x8870). TechnicsFileNaming_HandleOk (0xf95200) calls MainFuncCall(0x145000e, 0x01E00086, 0x2742c).

name: EVT_SET_DIAL_FOCUS
meaning: Firmware method MT_SetDialFocus. It sets which object receives the data-entry dial. The value is stored at 0x3ef6a, and 0x01C0002C is broadcast when it changes.
evidence: Name: entry 0x87 = "MT_SetDialFocus". Handler: GroupBoxProc (0xf9983f) branches to GroupBox_SetDialFocus (0xf9a46a), which calls SetDialFocus (0xf9a547). PsLabelBoxProc (0xf7eb2d) also handles it. Senders: IvSdtecd1Proc (0xf7e8a1) and Sdtecd1_Match (0xf7ea57) send it with parameter 1, and PsLabel_CheckSecondWidget sends it with 0.

name: EVT_GET_DIAL_FOCUS
meaning: Firmware method MT_GetDialFocus. It returns the current dial-focus value (0x3ef6a), or -1 while the dial is disabled (0x3ef50 == 0).
evidence: Name: entry 0x88 = "MT_GetDialFocus". Handler: GroupBoxProc (0xf9983f) branches to GroupBox_GetDialFocus (0xf9a464), which calls GetDialFocus (0xf9a564). No sender passes the literal in v10 or the HD-AE5000; code that needs the value calls GetDialFocus directly.

name: EVT_GET_STR_PTR
meaning: Firmware method MT_GetStrPtr. It returns the char pointer a text box displays. Subclasses override it to supply their text.
evidence: Name: entry 0x89 = "MT_GetStrPtr". Handlers: PsTextBoxProc (0xfa3b5d) branches to AcTrkSw_Select_HighTrack (0xfa3d0a, a misnomer), which returns the default string Str_No_0x514. AcLanguageTextProc (0xfa3d14) branches to AcTrkSw_ShowHide_CheckDirty (also a misnomer). PsSCTxtBox2Proc (0xf1daff) and PsStylCnvVerProc (0xf1e0cf) override it. Senders: AcTrkSw_Reset (0xfa3b82), PsTextBox's 0x01C0000F paint case, sends it to itself when no string is passed and draws the result. HDAE5000_AcLanguageText1Proc (0x28b554) handles and sends it.

name: EVT_GET_FIXED_COL_STR
meaning: Firmware method MT_GetFixedColStr. The grid box asks for the label of a fixed (header) column, and the handler copies the string into the caller's buffer.
evidence: Name: entry 0x8A = "MT_GetFixedColStr". Handlers: PsGridBoxProc (0xf9dd85) dispatches through its method jump table (Data_SoundEditorCharsLayout_0x376, i = event - 0x01E0008A). Case 0xf9e7f5 copies the default string 0xEAA1F2. AcGridBoxProc (0xf9e956) branches to AcGridBox_GetColText (0xf9eb75), and about 20 Ac*GridBoxProc classes override it. Senders: PsGridBox_ShowHide (0xf9def8) and PsGridBox_Confirm (0xf9e1c8).

name: EVT_GET_FIXED_ROW_STR
meaning: Firmware method MT_GetFixedRowStr. The grid box asks for the label of a fixed (header) row, and the handler copies the string into the caller's buffer.
evidence: Name: entry 0x8B = "MT_GetFixedRowStr". Handlers: the PsGridBoxProc (0xf9dd85) jump-table case 0xf9e7fc copies the default string 0xEAA212. AcGridBoxProc branches to AcGridBox_GetRowText (0xf9eb7f), and about 20 Ac*GridBoxProc classes override it. Senders: PsGridBox_ShowHide_ParseRows (0xf9e00a) and PsGridBox_Confirm_Rows (0xf9e2d0).

name: EVT_GRID_DRAW
meaning: Firmware method MT_GridDraw. It draws one grid cell. The parameter points to a {col, row, ...} record, where -1 means the current column or row.
evidence: Name: entry 0x8C = "MT_GridDraw". Handler: the PsGridBoxProc (0xf9dd85) jump-table case 0xf9e6b9 has no label of its own; the code falls inside PsGridBox_Scroll at +0x62. It copies the four-word record, replaces -1 with the current column (+46) or row (+42), computes the cell rectangle from the position tables at +50 and +54, and renders the cell. AcSndArgGridBoxProc (0xf1d268) overrides it. Senders: PsGridBoxProc case 0xf9e7b3 (MT_RequestGridDraw) sends it to itself, and about 180 sites in Ac* grid procedures send it (for example S2c_GridCheck_GetFocusSendEvt 0xf1b38a).

name: EVT_REQUEST_GRID_DRAW
meaning: Firmware method MT_RequestGridDraw. It asks for one cell to be redrawn. The parameter is (col<<16)|row, and the handler turns it into an MT_GridDraw sent to itself.
evidence: Name: entry 0x8D = "MT_RequestGridDraw". Handler: PsGridBoxProc jump-table case 0xf9e7b3 splits the parameter into two words, builds the record and sends 0x01E0008C to itself. S2cGridCheck (0xf1b294), EasyCmpGridCheck and others handle it. Senders: PsGridBox_Scroll_SendOldCell (0xf9e89b) and PsGridBox_Scroll_SendNewCell (0xf9e8c4), inside the MT_SetSelectedCel case, send it for the old cell and the new cell.

name: EVT_SET_SELECTED_CEL
meaning: Firmware method MT_SetSelectedCel. It selects a grid cell. The parameter is (col<<16)|row, and 0xFFFF in either half keeps that coordinate.
evidence: Name: entry 0x8E = "MT_SetSelectedCel". Handler: PsGridBoxProc jump-table case 0xf9e811. The code runs through PsGridBox_Scroll_DefaultRow, CheckRowChange, StoreCol, SendOldCell and SendNewCell, which are misnomers for steps of this case. On a row change it sends 0x01C0000E to itself, it stores the column at +46, and it sends MT_RequestGridDraw for the old cell and the new cell. Senders: CmpSetTtl_Dispatch (0xf67e92) and about 30 Ac* grid sites.

name: EVT_GET_SELECTED_CEL
meaning: Firmware method MT_GetSelectedCel. It returns the selected cell packed as (col<<16)|row.
evidence: Name: entry 0x8F = "MT_GetSelectedCel". Handler: PsGridBoxProc jump-table case 0xf9e8ed (PsGridBox_DispatchEvent+7) returns (*(inst+46)<<16) + *(inst+42). Senders: S2c_GridCheck_DataBlock (0xf1b2ce) and about 125 sites in drawbar_panel_ui.s and other grid users. The existing constant for this value is EVT_OBJECT_STATE_QUERY.

name: EVT_GET_SELECTED
meaning: Firmware method MT_GetSelected. It returns a list box's selected index.
evidence: Name: entry 0x90 = "MT_GetSelected". Handler: PsListBoxProc (0xf9d72e) branches to PsListBox_GetCount (0xf9db6c, a misnomer), which returns the sign-extended *(*(inst+38)), the selected index. The PsGridBoxProc jump table sends 0x90 to PsGridBox_Default, so it is not a grid method. Senders: MdPresetOKFunc (0xf76422), SystemInitOkFunc (0xfb7f48), ExcSendFunc (0xf7661b) and AcListBox_ScrollUpDown (0xf9dc5d) all ask a list for its selection.

name: EVT_CHECK_GRID_INDEX
meaning: Firmware method MT_CheckGridIndex. It checks whether an index lies in the grid's index window, which starts at inst+26 and is inst+38 long. The answer is 1 when the index is in range.
evidence: Name: entry 0x91 = "MT_CheckGridIndex". Handler: PsGridBoxProc jump-table case 0xf9e90d compares the parameter with *(inst+26), returns 0 when that field is -1, and returns 1 when param - start < *(inst+38). Senders: EasyCmp_SendEvt091 (0xf1c15d), ui_widget_defs.s:112 and :167, and about 40 sites in ui_mode_handlers.s and drawbar_panel_ui.s.

name: EVT_REQUEST_TRACK_SWITCH
meaning: Firmware method MT_RequestTrackSwitch. A track-switch widget sends it to the main function 0x0140000A to apply the track switch for a track or part. The parameter is the track id.
evidence: Name: entry 0x92 = "MT_RequestTrackSwitch". Handler: MainTrSwControl (0xf99148) calls SeqVoice_DispatchEventToHandler and then SeqVoice_ComputeStatusFlags. Senders: AcTrkSw_Catchall (0xfa3a72) calls MainFuncCall(0x140000a, 0x01E00092, *(inst+22)). TrackMixer_InitPartLoop (0xf807de) also sends it.

name: EVT_TOGGLE_TRACK_SWITCH
meaning: Firmware method MT_ToggleTrackSwitch. It toggles the track switch for the track or part in the parameter.
evidence: Name: entry 0x93 = "MT_ToggleTrackSwitch". Handler: MainTrSwControl (0xf99148) branches to MainTrSwControl_HandleChannel, which calls AppEvent_HandleChannelEvent. Sender: AcTrkSw_SpecialDispatch (0xfa3a95), after MT_CheckEditSw (0x01E00053) reports a hit, calls MainFuncCall(0x140000a, 0x01E00093, track).

name: EVT_CHECK_SHOW_WINDOW
meaning: Firmware method MT_CheckShowWindow. It asks whether a window is currently showing a sub-object, and returns 1 when *(inst+28) is not -1.
evidence: Name: entry 0x94 = "MT_CheckShowWindow". Handler: WindowProc (0xf9afb6) branches to WindowField_GetChildCount (0xf9b230, a misnomer), which returns *(*(inst+28)) != -1. Senders: IvPageControl_PageChange (0xfa1b1e) sends 0x01C00002 (EV_HIDE) to the window when this returns non-zero. IvMpst_HandlePageSwitch (0xf7629b), DrawCombo_InitWidget (0xf82e4c) and IvPageOverWr_PageSelect (0xfbd090) also send it.

name: EVT_INTERRUPT_HOLD
meaning: Firmware method MT_InterruptHold. It suspends the current title's interrupt timeout: if the title has an interrupt time, the pending 0x01C00028 ApTimer is killed.
evidence: Name: entry 0x98 = "MT_InterruptHold". Handler: TitleProc (0xfa4e03) branches to EnumList_PartChange_B (0xfa5496, a misnomer). When title entry +18 is not 0xFFFF, it calls KillApTimer for 0x01C00028. GroupBoxProc's table forwards the value to the current title (GroupBox_NavUpDown 0xf9a470). Sender: GroupBox_SndCmd_ProcessTitle (0xf99c4f) sends it to GetTitleNow before it switches title.

name: EVT_SET_INTERRUPT_TIME
meaning: Firmware method MT_SetInterruptTime. It (re)arms the title's interrupt timer, an ApTimer that delivers 0x01C00028 after the title's interrupt time (entry +18). Nothing happens when the title is held or has no time set.
evidence: Name: entry 0x99 = "MT_SetInterruptTime". Handler: TitleProc (0xfa4e03) branches to EnumList_Close (0xfa53b6, a misnomer). The timer is armed only when +18 is not 0xFFFF and the hold bit is clear, and arming goes through SetApTimer at EnumList_OK_ScrollUp. GroupBox forwards the value to the title. Senders: GroupBox_SndCmd_ProcessTitle (0xf99c4f) and GroupBox_HandleRefresh (0xf99dd2).

name: EVT_SET_HOLD
meaning: Firmware method MT_SetHold. It sets or clears the title's hold flag (bit 0 of the title-flags word at 0x2bc30). Setting it also kills the pending interrupt timer.
evidence: Name: entry 0x9A = "MT_SetHold". Handler: TitleProc (0xfa4e03) branches to EnumList_Paint (0xfa556a, a misnomer). With parameter 1 it calls KillApTimer and TitleProc_SetResourceDirtyFlag(1) (0xfa58c7). With 0 it clears the bit. CheckHold reads the same bit. Senders (46 sites): the medley players, for example IntMed_StartPlayLoop (0xf92154) with 0; SelfTest_SramAndRom (0xfb77d4) with 1; IvExitMode_OK_SaveCheck (0xfa1d12); and GroupBox_KeyHold_CheckRange (0xf9a131).

name: EVT_TOGGLE_HOLD
meaning: Firmware method MT_ToggleHold. It toggles the title's hold flag (0x2bc30 bit 0) and resets the interrupt timer.
evidence: Name: entry 0x9B = "MT_ToggleHold". Handler: TitleProc (0xfa4e03) branches to EnumList_Return (0xfa55f7, a misnomer), which tests bit 0 of 0x2bc30, calls ResetApTimer for 0x01C00028, and branches to TitleProc_ToggleFlag. Sender: CtrlPanel_EventType_A8 (0xf9838b) calls ApPostEvent(-1, 0x01E0009B, 0) on a panel switch.

name: EVT_SET_VISIBLE
meaning: Firmware method MT_SetVisible. It shows or hides a view: parameter 0 sets bit 0 of the view flags at instance+12 (hidden), and a non-zero parameter clears it (visible). It is not an activation event.
evidence: Name: entry 0x9C = "MT_SetVisible". Handler: ViewableProc (0xfa5995) branches to Viewable_SetVisible (0xfa5c4d), which calls SetVisible (0xfa5e8c). PsEditSwBoxProc (0xfa09cf) and PsToggleBoxProc (0xfa1590) repaint on it. Senders: FileIO_DiskRemoved (0xf8b1df) calls ApPostEvent(0x00600002, 0x01E0009C, 0), which hides view 0x600002. CDlikeSwTtl_SendStartEvtArg1 (0xf2294b), SingleLoadDstFunc (0xf90dbf) and SeqAccomp_StartAndPostEvents (0xf45b95) send it with 1 or 0. The existing constant for this value is EVT_POST_ACTIVATE.

name: EVT_GET_INTERRUPT_TIME
meaning: Firmware method MT_GetInterruptTime. It returns an interrupt view's timeout interval.
evidence: Name: entry 0x9D = "MT_GetInterruptTime". Handlers: IvInterruptProc (0xfa2147) branches to IvInterrupt_GetInterval. IvIntReminderProc, IvIntCompleteProc, IvIntErrorProc, IvIntVariProc and IvIntEasySetProc return their own intervals, and IvIntWelcomeProc (0xfa232c) returns 1. Senders: IvInterrupt_Init (0xfa218a) and IvInterrupt_CheckActive (0xfa21f6) send it to themselves.

name: EVT_SET_NOT_DRAW_FLAG
meaning: Firmware method MT_SetNotDrawFlag. It sets or clears the title's do-not-draw flag (bit 2, value 0x4, of the title flags at 0x2bc30) to suppress screen drawing.
evidence: Name: entry 0x9E = "MT_SetNotDrawFlag". Handler: TitleProc (0xfa4e03) branches to EnumList_OK_ScrollDown (0xfa56b9, a misnomer). A non-zero parameter calls TitleProc_SetResourceDirtyFlag(4), and 0 clears the bit. CheckNotDrawFlag (0xfa589f) tests it. Senders: MainTitle_InitGraphicsAndEvents (0xf9800f) calls PostEvent(0x01A00000, 0x01E0009E, 1) at boot, MainTitle_TeardownAndLoop sends 0, and GroupBox_HandlePartChange (0xf99961) brackets a redraw with 1 and 0.

name: EVT_GET_LANGUAGE_PTR
meaning: Firmware method MT_GetLanguagePtr. A language-text view asks its function for its table of per-language strings, then draws the entry for the current language (0x340e4).
evidence: Name: entry 0x9F = "MT_GetLanguagePtr". Sender: AcLanguageTextProc (0xfa3d14), on 0x01C0000D, calls ApFuncCall(*(inst+38), 0x01E0009F, 0), indexes the result by the byte at 0x340e4, and sends 0x01C0000F with that string. Handlers: LanguageCheck (0xfa3d6c) returns Str_No_0x52E, and about 78 other check functions answer it (medley.s, drawbar_panel_ui.s:9129 and others).

name: EVT_PART_SELECT_PUT
meaning: Firmware method MT_PartSelectPut. It writes the selected part (0-15, 0x15 or 0x16) to 0x8d3a and to the panel switch board through AddswbWr(0x90, 0x10, part), which updates the part-select indication.
evidence: Name: entry 0xA0 = "MT_PartSelectPut". Handler: MainPmanControl (0xf99177) branches to MainPmanCtrl_HandleA0 (0xf99295), which stores the part at 0x8d3a and calls AddswbWr when the value changes. Senders: MidiPart_StorePartIndex (0xf7a38e), IvSdpart_Close_SetUndo (0xf7b822; parameter 0x3F), PsMixer_Case1_PartSelect (0xf7fbf3) and AudioCtrl_SetupPartDisplay (0xf80062), all through MainFuncCall.

name: EVT_GET_BITMAP_DATA
meaning: Firmware method MT_GetBitmapData. A bitmap resource answers it with the ROM address of its pixel data.
evidence: Name: entry 0xA1 = "MT_GetBitmapData". Handlers: BitmapDrawsw (0xf7b4c7) branches to BitmapDrawsw_DataPtr; BitmapTechnics (0xf7b578), BitmapKn5000 (0xf7b5a5) and UserBitmapCheck (0xf9c5d5) answer the same way, as do HDAE5000_BitmapHdd_icon (0x280395) and HDAE5000_Alloc_Memory* (0x28030e and others). Senders: VwUserBitmap_HandlePaint (0xf9c562), UserBitmapSp_Paint (0xf840de) and HDAE5000_TtlScreenRProc (0x280489) ask through ApFuncCall. The existing constant for this value is EVT_ALLOC_DATA_PTR.

name: EVT_GET_BITMAP_WIDTH
meaning: Firmware method MT_GetBitmapWidth. A bitmap resource answers it with its width in pixels.
evidence: Name: entry 0xA2 = "MT_GetBitmapWidth". Handlers: the same Bitmap* procedures (BitmapDrawsw 0xf7b4c7 returns 294; the HD-AE5000 descriptors return 320, 27 or 42). Senders: VwUserBitmap_HandlePaint (0xf9c562), UserBitmapSp_Paint (0xf840de) and HDAE5000_Boot_Init (0x28f576). The existing constant for this value is EVT_ALLOC_WIDTH.

name: EVT_GET_BITMAP_HEIGHT
meaning: Firmware method MT_GetBitmapHeight. A bitmap resource answers it with its height in pixels.
evidence: Name: entry 0xA3 = "MT_GetBitmapHeight". Handlers: the same Bitmap* procedures (BitmapDrawsw 0xf7b4c7; the slider bitmaps return 222; the HD-AE5000 descriptors return 240, 27 or 15). Senders: VwUserBitmap_HandlePaint (0xf9c562) and UserBitmapSp_Paint (0xf840de). The existing constant for this value is EVT_ALLOC_HEIGHT.

name: EVT_EASY_SET_ON
meaning: Firmware method MT_EasySetOn. A panel button has been pressed. The title starts an ApTimer that delivers MT_EasySetGo if the button stays down, which implements press-and-hold to jump to that button's setting screen. The parameter is the button index.
evidence: Name: entry 0xA5 = "MT_EasySetOn". Handler: TitleProc (0xfa4e03) branches to EnumList_OK_ScrollDown_Done (0xfa56cd, a misnomer), which pushes 0x01E000B7 and calls SetApTimer with the button's entry in table Str_No_0x602. GroupBoxProc's table forwards the value to the title. Senders: CtrlPanel_AA_PanelEvent_0F (0xf9842e), CtrlPanel_AA_PanelEvent_12 and _0E_Bit3 on a key press, with parameters 0, 1 and 2.

name: EVT_EASY_SET_OFF
meaning: Firmware method MT_EasySetOff. The panel button has been released before the hold time, so the title kills the pending MT_EasySetGo timer.
evidence: Name: entry 0xA6 = "MT_EasySetOff". Handler: TitleProc (0xfa4e03) branches to EnumList_OK_ScrollUp_Wrap (0xfa56e5, a misnomer), which calls KillApTimer for event 0x01E000B7. Senders: CtrlPanel_AA_0F_Release (0xf98442) and CtrlPanel_AA_12_Release, on key release.

name: EVT_REFRESH_PARA_DRAW
meaning: Firmware method MT_RefreshParaDraw. It asks a parameter display (drawbar, mixer slider, RAM box) to redraw from current data. The parameter selects which element.
evidence: Name: entry 0xA7 = "MT_RefreshParaDraw". Handlers: IvDrawbarProc (0xf824c4) branches to IvDrawbar_DrawbarUpdate. IvDrawbar1Proc (0xf8334f), IvDrawbarNormProc (0xf839e5, through DrawbarNorm_Update 0xf83a75) and PsMixerControlProc (0xf7fa5a) handle it, and AcRamBoxProc (0xf9d06d) branches to AcRamBox_HandleDataRefresh (0xf9d107). GroupBox forwards it to the box procedure. Senders: SeqRecPlay_EnableRecordOnly (0xf22a5d) through ApPostEvent, IvDrawbar_ShowHide (0xf8269b) with parameters 1-3, and ParaLoadOpt_CaseA (0xf768d9).

name: EVT_SET_SOUND_SW_NO
meaning: Firmware method MT_SetSoundSwNo. It sets the sound-switch (sound selection) number for a part. The packed parameter is distributed to the MIDI channels.
evidence: Name: entry 0xA8 = "MT_SetSoundSwNo". Handler: MainGetSoundName (0xf98cae) branches to Sound_SetSelection (0xf98dd4), which calls MIDI_DistributeParamToChannels. Senders: IvAccordion_PageSelect (0xf7e4aa) and IvDrawbar2_OKHandler (0xf8396f), through MainFuncCall.

name: EVT_ADD_SOUND_SW_NO
meaning: Firmware method MT_AddSoundSwNo. It steps a part's sound-switch number by a delta, which is relative sound navigation.
evidence: Name: entry 0xA9 = "MT_AddSoundSwNo". Handler: MainGetSoundName (0xf98cae) branches to Sound_Navigate_Entry (0xf98e13); only parts at or below 0xf and 0x15-0x16 are accepted. Sender: PsMixer_CtlTypeProc1_Skip7 (0xf82198), through MainFuncCall.

name: EVT_CHECK_HOLD
meaning: Firmware method MT_CheckHold. It returns whether the current title's hold flag (0x2bc30 bit 0) is set.
evidence: Name: entry 0xAA = "MT_CheckHold". Handler: TitleProc (0xfa4e03) branches to EnumList_Confirm_Forward (0xfa5558, a misnomer), which returns (0x2bc30 & 1) != 0. GroupBox forwards it to the title. Sender: GroupBox_HandlePartChange (0xf99961) sends it to GetTitleNow and ignores the part change while the title is held.

name: EVT_OTHER_PART_LED
meaning: Firmware method MT_OtherPartLed. It requests the 'other part' panel LED on (1) or off (0). MainTitleControl applies the request 10 main-loop passes later by setting or clearing bit 0 of 0x8f5c and calling CtrlPanel_SetIndicatorBit(0x60).
evidence: Name: entry 0xAB = "MT_OtherPartLed". Handler: MainTitleControl (0xf992f5) branches to MainTitleCtrl_HandleAB (0xf993ce), which stores the parameter at 0x274ac and a countdown of 10 at 0x274ae. MainTitleCtrl_HandleBB (0xf993ea) applies it on expiry. Senders: IvWindowPgCtl_SetPageIndex (0xfbce4c) and the other IvWindowPgCtl_* cases (parameter 1 or 0), plus AudioCtrl_MainFuncCallPt (0xf7fb96), through MainFuncCall.

name: EVT_SLEEP_MAIN_TASK
meaning: Firmware method MT_SleepMainTask. It suspends the main task while the application task runs. The firmware's own routine SleepMainTask sends it.
evidence: Name: entry 0xAC = "MT_SleepMainTask". Sender: SleepMainTask (0xf9883c) calls ApTaskControl(0x0120000B, 0x01E000AC, 0). Screen_Init_SetWall (0xf9a7ab) calls SleepMainTask, and drawbar_panel_ui.s:11439 and :18149 also send it. Handlers: ApTaskControl (0xf987a1) branches to ApTaskCtrl_HandleAC, which calls MainFuncCall(0x0140000C) and then TaskSched_Resume. MainTaskControl (0xf987e9) calls TaskSched_WakeBySlotID(4) and then Resume. GroupBox maps it to GroupBox_ReturnZero.

name: EVT_WAKE_UP_MAIN_TASK
meaning: Firmware method MT_WakeUpMainTask. It wakes the main task. The firmware's own routine WakeUpMainTask sends it.
evidence: Name: entry 0xAD = "MT_WakeUpMainTask". Sender: WakeUpMainTask (0xf9884b) calls ApTaskControl(0x0120000B, 0x01E000AD, 0), and Screen_Init_SetWall calls WakeUpMainTask. Handlers: ApTaskControl (0xf987a1) branches to ApTaskCtrl_HandleAD, which calls TaskSched_WakeBySlotID(1). MainTaskControl (0xf987e9) returns 0.

name: EVT_SLEEP_AP_TASK
meaning: Firmware method MT_SleepApTask. It suspends the application (Ap) task. The firmware's own routine SleepApTask sends it.
evidence: Name: entry 0xAE = "MT_SleepApTask". Sender: SleepApTask (0xf9885a) calls MainTaskControl(0x0120000B, 0x01E000AE, 0). Handlers: MainTaskControl (0xf987e9) calls ApPostEvent(-1, ...) and then TaskSched_Resume. ApTaskControl (0xf987a1) calls TaskSched_WakeBySlotID(1) and then Resume.

name: EVT_WAKE_UP_AP_TASK
meaning: Firmware method MT_WakeUpApTask. It wakes the application task. The firmware's own routine WakeUpApTask sends it.
evidence: Name: entry 0xAF = "MT_WakeUpApTask". Sender: WakeUpApTask (0xf98868) calls MainTaskControl(0x0120000B, 0x01E000AF, 0). Handlers: MainTaskControl (0xf987e9) branches to MainTaskCtrl_HandleAF, which calls TaskSched_WakeBySlotID(4). ApTaskControl returns 0.

name: EVT_REFRESH_AP_TASK
meaning: Firmware method MT_RefreshApTask. It resets the application task's input state: it clears switch state, deletes queued switch, mode and title events, and posts this method. GroupBox then disables the dial, re-initialises the timers and sends MT_RefreshSwEvent.
evidence: Name: entry 0xB0 = "MT_RefreshApTask". Sender: RefreshApTask (0xf98877) calls DeleteEvent for 0x01C00007/8/9/1C/1F/14/15/16, then ApPostEvent(-1, 0x01E000B0, 0). ui_widget_defs.s:9815 also sends it. Handlers: MainTaskControl (0xf987e9) branches to MainTaskCtrl_HandleB0. GroupBoxProc's jump-table case 0xf9a48c (GroupBox_NavUpDown+28) calls SetDialEnable(0), sets 0x3ef6a to -1, calls InitializeTimer, and sends 0x01E000B4 to itself.

name: EVT_GET_BOX_BORDER
meaning: Firmware method MT_GetBoxBorder. A box returns its border/wallpaper pattern (instance word +0x18). Screen setup uses the answer as the wallpaper.
evidence: Name: entry 0xB1 = "MT_GetBoxBorder". Handlers: BoxProc (0xf99581) branches to BoxProc_HandleB1 (0xf995c1). VwBoxProc (0xf9cce6) branches to VwBox_HandleGetHeight, which reads the same +0x18 word (the label is a misnomer). IvDirmdScreenProc (0xf9ac62) overrides it. Sender: Screen_Init_SetWall (0xf9a7ab) passes the result to SetWallPaper.

name: EVT_GET_BOX_COLOR
meaning: Firmware method MT_GetBoxColor. A box returns its colour (instance word +0x16). Screen setup uses the answer as the wall colour.
evidence: Name: entry 0xB2 = "MT_GetBoxColor". Handlers: BoxProc (0xf99581) branches to BoxProc_HandleB2 (0xf995ca), and VwBoxProc (0xf9cce6) branches to VwBox_HandleGetColor. Sender: Screen_Init_SetWall (0xf9a7ab) passes the result to SetWallColor.

name: EVT_SET_KEEP
meaning: Firmware method MT_SetKeep. It sets (non-zero parameter, which also kills the interrupt timer) or clears the title's keep flag (0x10 in the title flags at 0x2bc30).
evidence: Name: entry 0xB3 = "MT_SetKeep". Handler: TitleProc (0xfa4e03) branches to EnumList_ValueChange_A (0xfa54c9, a misnomer), which calls KillApTimer for 0x01C00028 and then TitleProc_SetResourceDirtyFlag(0x10). GroupBox forwards it to the title. Senders: IvMesageProc (0xf7dd23), IvAccordionProc (0xf7e250), AudioCtrl_SendB3Event (0xf7fb86) and PsMixer_ControlHandler (0xf7fb04) send 1. AcWelcomScreen_RenderBytecode (0xf7f649) sends 0.

name: EVT_REFRESH_SW_EVENT
meaning: Firmware method MT_RefreshSwEvent. It flushes held-switch state: it clears switch state, deletes queued 0x01C00007/8/9 events, and sends 0x01C00009 to every switch still marked active, which releases them. The firmware's own routine RefreshSwEvent posts it.
evidence: Name: entry 0xB4 = "MT_RefreshSwEvent". Sender: RefreshSwEvent (0xf98926) clears 0x27849a-0x2749e-0x274a2, deletes 0x01C00008/7/9, then calls ApPostEvent(-1, 0x01E000B4, 0). The GroupBox case for MT_RefreshApTask also sends it. Handler: GroupBoxProc jump-table case 0xf9a4af (GroupBox_NavDispatch+6) loops over the 0x274e8 table (17 entries, both halves) and sends 0x01C00009 to each active entry.

name: EVT_SEARCH_LINK
meaning: Firmware method MT_SearchLink. It searches the view tree for a view that answers another method. The parameter is the method id to ask; the view sends it to itself, then recurses to its superview and subviews, and returns 1 when some view answers non-zero.
evidence: Name: entry 0xB5 = "MT_SearchLink". Handler: ViewableProc (0xfa5995) branches to Viewable_MatchClass (0xfa5caa, a misnomer), which does SendEvent(self, param), then View_GetSuperViewInstance and child recursion. Senders: GroupBox_SndCmd_ProcessTitle (0xf99c4f) calls SendEvent(start screen from MT_GetStartScreen 0x01E00033, 0x01E000B5, 0x01E000B6). IvMessage_SelectionChange (0xf7ddff) sends the same request.

name: EVT_INTERRUPT_OFF
meaning: Firmware method MT_InterruptOff. It asks whether a view is an interrupt view whose timeout is off (interval 0). It is used as the probe passed to MT_SearchLink before the firmware decides whether to hold the title's interrupt timer.
evidence: Name: entry 0xB6 = "MT_InterruptOff". Handlers: IvInterruptProc (0xfa2147) branches to IvInterrupt_CheckActive (0xfa21f6), which returns (MT_GetInterruptTime == 0). IvMesageProc (0xf7dd23) branches to IvMessage_SelectionChange. Senders: it is passed as the parameter of MT_SearchLink by GroupBox_SndCmd_ProcessTitle (0xf99c4f); a hit there skips MT_InterruptHold. IvMessage_SelectionChange (0xf7ddff) passes it the same way.

name: EVT_EASY_SET_GO
meaning: Firmware method MT_EasySetGo. The press-and-hold timer armed by MT_EasySetOn has expired. The title clears its hold flag and sends the button's own (object, event, parameter) request from table Str_No_0x602, which opens that button's setting screen.
evidence: Name: entry 0xB7 = "MT_EasySetGo". Handler: TitleProc (0xfa4e03) branches to EnumList_HitTest (0xfa5730, a misnomer). It calls DeleteEvent for queued 0x01E000B7 and skips when the mode is 0x01800013 (or 0x01800001 for title requests). It then sends SendEvent(-1, MT_SetHold, 0), sets title flag 0x20, sends the Str_No_0x602 row through SendEvent, and clears 0x20. Sender: the ApTimer that EnumList_OK_ScrollDown_Done (0xfa56cd) arms with event 0x01E000B7. EnumList_OK_ScrollUp_Wrap and EnumList_OK_ScrollUp_Done kill or re-arm that timer.

name: EVT_CHECK_INIT_DATA
meaning: Firmware method MT_CheckInitData. It asks whether a parameter has an initial (reset/centre) value. The answer is 1 when it does.
evidence: Name: entry 0xB8 = "MT_CheckInitData". Handlers: LswPan (0xf7ce91) branches to LswPan_ReturnOne. LswKeyShift (0xf7d40a), LswTuning (0xf7d50e), LswMasterTuning (0xf7ed70) and LswScalingKeyX (0xf7f237) also return 1. Senders: AcLswEdit_ResetBtn (0xf9f7c7), AcLswPartEdit_Snap (0xf7c029) and PsMixer_CtlTypeProc3_Skip8 (0xf811e4) call ApFuncCall and then ask MT_GetInitData when the answer is non-zero.

name: EVT_GET_INIT_DATA
meaning: Firmware method MT_GetInitData. It returns a parameter's initial (reset/centre) value. The reset button stores this value.
evidence: Name: entry 0xB9 = "MT_GetInitData". Handlers: LswPan branches to LswPan_ReturnCenter, LswKeyShift to LswKeyShift_ReturnCenter, and LswTuning to LswTuning_ReturnCenter. LswMasterTuning (0xf7ed70) returns 0, and LswScalingKeyX branches to LswScaleKeyX_ReturnRange. Senders: AcLswEdit_ResetBtn (0xf9f7c7), AcLswPartEdit_Snap (0xf7c029) and PsMixer_CtlTypeProc7_Skip7 (0xf81524).

name: EVT_SET_TITLE_FLAG
meaning: Firmware method MT_SetTitleFlag. It reports the new title-flags word (0x2bc30: hold 0x1, not-draw 0x4, vari 0x8, keep 0x10, easy-set 0x20) to the main title function. That function latches it into 0x274a6 after 10 main-loop passes, and the panel selection state is read from there.
evidence: Name: entry 0xBA = "MT_SetTitleFlag". Senders: TitleProc_SetResourceDirtyFlag (0xfa58c7) and TitleProc_ClearResourceDirtyFlag (0xfa58e0), both misnomers for 'set/clear title flag', call MainFuncCall(0x01400001, 0x01E000BA, flags). TitleProc_ToggleFlag (0xfa567c) also sends it. Handler: MainTitleControl (0xf992f5) branches to MainTitleCtrl_HandleBA (0xf993dc), which stores the flags at 0x274a8 with a countdown of 10 at 0x274aa. CtrlPanel_GetSelectionState reads 0x274a6.

name: EVT_MAIN_LOOP_COUNT
meaning: Firmware method MT_MainLoopCount. It is the per-pass tick of the main loop sent to the main title function. That function counts down the delayed title-flag latch and the other-part LED update.
evidence: Name: entry 0xBB = "MT_MainLoopCount". Sender: MainTitle_PrepareAndDispatch (0xf980ee) calls MainTitleControl(..., 0x01E000BB, 0) on every pass. Handler: MainTitleControl (0xf992f5) branches to MainTitleCtrl_HandleBB (0xf993ea), which decrements 0x274aa (then copies 0x274a8 to 0x274a6) and 0x274ae (then applies the LED request).

meaning: Not an object id: the third 32-bit word of the expected rhythm-ROM header at 0x400008 (bytes 05 83 00 01); RhythmROM_ValidateHeader compares 0x400000/04/08 against 0x05040100, 0x04010083, 0x01008305 and stores -1 to 0x3277 on mismatch. Function table 0x100 has only 352 entries, so index 0x8305 is no Function.
evidence: RhythmROM_ValidateHeader@0xF54651 (seq_audio_mode.s:1623 cp xwa,0x1008305 -> AccChord_CheckFailed). Only site.

meaning: Not an object id: AudioMix_Init initial data word for the audio/mixer register file at 0x150000 (latch at 0x150000, data at 0x150002). The loop copies A (0x1F,0x3F,0x5F,0x7F) into W and stores XWA, i.e. writes data 0x0101 to registers 0x1F1F..0x7F7F. It coincides with Function 0x0101001F (AcFdemoScreenProc) only numerically.

name: NAKA_FUNC_AcTransposeBoxProc

name: NAKA_APFUNC_DefaultFunction
meaning: NAKA ApFunction object id: entry 0 of the Root ApFunction table (registry slot 0x120), firmware name "DefaultFunction". Root ApFunction 0 (no-op). name: NAKA_APFUNC_NamingCheck
meaning: NAKA ApFunction object id: entry 5 of the Root ApFunction table (registry slot 0x120), firmware name "NamingCheck". Root ApFunction 5: the default naming-validation function. The naming window stores it in its check-function variable when none is set, then calls ApFuncCall(check, MT_GetStringLength 0x01E0007C). name: NAKA_MAINFUNC_MainTitleControl
